title: Adapting Generalist Robot Policies with Semantic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Generalist robot policies learn a diverse repertoire of behaviors from large-scale pretraining. In principle, this makes them excellent priors for downstream adaptation via reinforcement learning (RL). In practice, however, standard RL methods leveraging this prior optimize directly over robot actions, requiring the base policy's action distribution to be close to that of a performant policy from the start. This assumption breaks down for complex or long-horizon tasks that fall outside the pretraining distribution. Our key insight is that, for sufficiently expressive generalist policies, language prompts are an effective alternative space for learning to solve such tasks: modulating language inputs elicits skills already within the policy's repertoire, which can be composed to solve tasks beyond its zero-shot capabilities. We propose Semantic Action Reinforcement Learning (SARL), which learns to optimize this prompt space through online interaction, treating the generalist policy as a controllable skill prior. Importantly, leveraging pretrained skills rather than learning new ones from scratch yields structured, semantically meaningful exploration and highly efficient online improvement, and learning to modulate prompts through experience grounds them in induced real-world behaviors for robust task-solving. Across real-world settings and simulated benchmarks, we show SARL unlocks fundamentally new capabilities -- adapting VLA behavior to solve complex, long-horizon tasks -- and significantly outperforms existing approaches for improving robot behavior in deployment.
tldr: Semantic Action Reinforcement Learning (SARL) treats language prompts as an action space to adapt pretrained generalist robot policies (VLAs) online, enabling efficient RL-based task solving for complex, long-horizon behaviors.
tldr_zh: 语义动作强化学习（SARL）将语言提示视为动作空间，在线适配预训练的通用机器人策略（VLA），从而为复杂、长时程任务实现高效的强化学习求解。
summary_zh: 通用型机器人策略通过大规模预训练学习到多样化的行为技能。原则上，这使其成为通过强化学习进行下游适配的优质先验。然而在实践中，利用该先验的标准强化学习方法直接优化机器人动作，要求基础策略的动作分布从初始阶段就接近高效策略的动作分布。对于超出预训练分布范围的复杂或长周期任务，这一假设难以成立。我们关键洞察在于：对于具有充分表现力的通用型策略而言，语言提示是学习解决此类任务的有效替代空间——通过调节语言输入可调用策略库中已有的技能，并通过组合这些技能解决超出其零样本能力范畴的任务。我们提出语义动作强化学习（SARL），该方法通过在线交互学习优化这一提示空间，将通用型策略视为可控的技能先验。重要的是，利用预训练技能而非从头学习新技能，能够产生结构化且具有语义意义的探索行为，实现高效的在线优化；通过经验学习调节提示，可将这些提示与诱导出的真实世界行为建立关联，从而稳健地完成任务求解。在真实场景与仿真测试中，我们证明SARL解锁了根本性新能力——通过调整视觉语言动作（VLA）行为解决复杂长周期任务——并在部署场景中显著优于现有机器人行为改进方法。

title: Z-1: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising framework for robotic manipulation by connecting language instructions, visual observations, and continuous control. However, most existing policies remain limited by behavior cloning or supervised fine-tuning (SFT) from fixed demonstrations, which provides limited opportunity to improve from the policy's own failures. In this paper, we present Z-1, a reinforcement learning (RL) post-training framework for flow-based VLA models. Built on top of $π_{0.5}$, Z-1 uses only publicly released RoboCasa demonstrations for SFT and then applies a task-wise Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) strategy across $24$ standard RoboCasa tasks. To improve the efficiency and stability of online optimization, Z-1 combines shared-prefix rollout construction, tree-structured trajectory branching, completion-aware reward calibration, and selective joint training of VLM and Action Expert. Across all $24$ RoboCasa tasks, Z-1 achieves an average success rate of $80.6\%$, improving over its SFT initialization by $13.2\%$ points and outperforms the published sota models. These results show that systematic GRPO post-training can substantially improve flow-based VLA policies without additional private demonstrations.
tldr: Z-1 applies GRPO-based reinforcement learning post-training to a flow-based VLA policy, achieving significant success-rate improvements on 24 RoboCasa tasks without additional private data.
tldr_zh: Z-1 将基于 GRPO 的强化学习后训练应用于基于流的 VLA 策略，在没有额外私有数据的情况下，在 24 个 RoboCasa 任务上实现了显著的成功率提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过连接语言指令、视觉观测和连续控制，为机器人操作提供了一种有前景的框架。然而，现有大多数策略仍受限于行为克隆或基于固定示教的监督微调（SFT），这使策略难以从自身失败中学习改进。本文提出Z-1——一种面向基于流的VLA模型的强化学习（RL）后训练框架。Z-1基于$π_{0.5}$构建，仅使用公开的RoboCasa示教数据进行SFT，随后在24个标准RoboCasa任务上应用任务级分组相对策略优化（GRPO）策略。为提升在线优化的效率与稳定性，Z-1结合了共享前缀轨迹生成、树结构轨迹分支、完成度感知奖励校准，以及视觉语言模型（VLM）与动作专家模块的选择性联合训练。在所有24个RoboCasa任务中，Z-1的平均成功率达到80.6%，较其SFT初始化提升了13.2个百分点，并超越已发布的最优模型。这些结果表明，系统化的GRPO后训练能在无需额外私有示教数据的情况下显著提升基于流的VLA策略。

title: Revisiting Parameter Redundancy in Vision-Language-Action Models: Insights from VLM-to-VLA Adaptation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made significant strides in embodied intelligence by integrating the powerful representations of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, the massive parameter scale of VLAs imposes a heavy computational burden, and these models exhibit extreme sensitivity to parameter pruning. Current paradigms often treat the resulting performance degradation as inevitable, relying on fine-tuning or low-rank corrections to recover efficacy. We challenge this convention by questioning whether the removed parameters are truly redundant if VLA pruning necessitates performance recovery to be effective, or if this paradigm masks the indiscriminate pruning of critical parameters. We revisit parameter redundancy through the lens of VLM-to-VLA adaptation, first quantifying the spatial distribution of parameter divergence during adaptation to reveal structured patterns across different modules. Subsequently, we introduce controlled pruning as a diagnostic probe: by comparing the direct impact of removing different parameter subsets on VLA performance without any fine-tuning, we establish a causal link between adaptation-induced divergence signals and functional contributions. Based on the discovered modular heterogeneities, we design a multi-module joint pruning scheme. Evaluations on the LIBERO benchmark demonstrate that our approach reduces the parameters of OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$ by 12\%--30\% while maintaining approximately 90\% of the original performance without any post-pruning recovery. In contrast, existing parameter pruning criteria result in total performance collapse when evaluated under the same recovery-free constraints. Our study reveals the parameter evolution mechanism in VLA adaptation and provides a new path for deploying efficient, robust robotic policies in resource-constrained environments.
tldr: This paper investigates parameter redundancy in VLA models by analyzing parameter divergence during VLM-to-VLA adaptation, and proposes a multi-module joint pruning scheme that reduces parameters by 12%-30% while maintaining ~90% performance without any post-pruning recovery.
tldr_zh: 本文通过分析VLM到VLA适应过程中的参数发散，研究了VLA模型的参数冗余，并提出了一种多模块联合剪枝方案，在不进行剪枝后恢复的情况下减少12%-30%的参数，同时保持约90%的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型通过整合预训练视觉-语言模型(VLM)的强大表征能力，在具身智能领域取得了显著进展。然而，VLA庞大的参数量带来了沉重的计算负担，且这类模型对参数剪枝表现出极端敏感性。当前的范式通常将由此带来的性能退化视为不可避免的结果，依赖微调或低秩修正来恢复效能。我们挑战这一惯例，提出以下质疑：若VLA剪枝必须通过性能恢复才得以生效，这是否意味着被移除的参数真正冗余？抑或这种范式掩盖了对关键参数的盲目剪枝？我们从VLM到VLA适配的角度重新审视参数冗余问题：首先量化适配过程中参数偏移的空间分布，揭示不同模块间的结构化模式；继而引入受控剪枝作为诊断探针——通过在无任何微调条件下直接比较移除不同参数子集对VLA性能的影响，建立适配诱导的偏移信号与功能贡献之间的因果关联。基于所发现的模块异质性，我们设计了多模块联合剪枝方案。在LIBERO基准上的评估表明，该方法可将OpenVLA和$π_{0.5}$的参数规模缩减12%-30%，同时在不经任何剪枝后恢复的情况下保持约90%的原始性能。相比之下，现有参数剪枝准则在相同无恢复约束条件下评估时导致性能完全崩溃。本研究揭示了VLA适配中的参数演化机制，为在资源受限环境中部署高效、鲁棒的机器人策略提供了新路径。

title: GaussianMap: Learning Gaussian Representation for Multi-Sensor Online HD Map Construction
summary: Autonomous driving systems benefit from high-definition (HD) maps that provide critical information about road infrastructure. The online construction of HD maps offers a scalable approach to generate local vectorized maps from onboard sensor observations. Existing methods commonly adopt bird's-eye-view (BEV) features as the intermediate scene representation, encoding the surrounding space with fixed-resolution dense grids. However, map elements are spatially sparse yet require fine-grained geometric localization, making uniformly allocated BEV representations redundant and less effective for vectorized map prediction. In this work, we propose GaussianMap, an online HD map construction framework that learns an adaptive Gaussian representation of the surrounding scene. This representation consists of a set of Gaussian primitives on the BEV plane, each encoding a flexible local region with geometric properties and a feature vector, allowing the model to allocate representational capacity to map-relevant regions. To generate such a representation from sensor observations, we introduce a feed-forward Gaussian encoder that progressively refines these primitives through Gaussian interaction modeling and multi-sensor feature aggregation. The refined Gaussian representation is then splatted into a BEV feature map and decoded into vectorized map predictions. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that GaussianMap achieves state-of-the-art performance in both camera-only and camera-LiDAR fusion settings. Our code will be made publicly available.
tldr: GaussianMap proposes an adaptive Gaussian representation for online HD map construction from multi-sensor inputs, replacing fixed BEV grids with flexible Gaussian primitives that focus on map-relevant regions, achieving SOTA results on nuScenes and Argoverse 2.
tldr_zh: GaussianMap提出了一种自适应高斯表示用于多传感器在线高清地图构建，用灵活的高斯基元替代固定BEV网格，聚焦地图相关区域，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上达到SOTA。
summary_zh: 自主驾驶系统受益于提供道路基础设施关键信息的高清地图。在线构建高清地图是一种可扩展的方法，能够从车载传感器观测中生成局部矢量地图。现有方法通常采用鸟瞰视角（BEV）特征作为中间场景表示，以固定分辨率的密集网格对周围空间进行编码。然而，地图元素在空间上是稀疏的，却需要细粒度的几何定位，这使得均匀分配的BEV表示对于矢量地图预测而言既冗余又低效。在本工作中，我们提出GaussianMap——一种在线高清地图构建框架，该框架学习周围场景的自适应高斯表示。该表示由BEV平面上的一组高斯图元组成，每个图元编码一个具有几何属性和特征向量的灵活局部区域，从而使模型能够将表示能力分配到与地图相关的区域。为了从传感器观测中生成这种表示，我们引入了一种前馈高斯编码器，通过高斯交互建模和多传感器特征聚合逐步优化这些图元。优化后的高斯表示随后被投射到BEV特征图中，并解码为矢量地图预测结果。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上的大量实验表明，GaussianMap在仅摄像头以及摄像头与激光雷达融合的场景下均达到了最先进的性能。我们的代码将公开提供。

title: DVG-WM: Disentangled Video Generation Enables Efficient Embodied World Model for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Video-based embodied world models provide an appealing substrate for robotic manipulation by predicting future states, yet current approaches remain limited by a fundamental entanglement: accurately modeling dynamics typically requires low-level temporal reasoning, while producing high-resolution frames demands expansive visual synthesis according to high-level semantics. This entanglement results in slow inference speed for iterative planning or too coarse predictions to retain contact-rich details. To solve this dilemma, we present Disentangled Video Generation World Model (DVG-WM), an efficient framework that explicitly decomposes world modeling into dynamics learning and visual synthesis. Conditioned on an initial observation and a language instruction, our model first generates a plausible sequence of intermediate visual states to preview the physical interaction and refines them to obtain high-fidelity videos. Furthermore, an efficient cascading mechanism is proposed, where DVG-WM uses flow matching to directly map the dynamics to video latents, and introduces a latent degradation mechanism to regenerate contact-rich details. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world platforms demonstrate improved video quality with up to 3.97 times acceleration, validating that disentangled video generation can be an efficient embodied world model for robotic manipulation.
tldr: DVG-WM disentangles world modeling into dynamics learning and visual synthesis for efficient robotic manipulation video prediction, achieving up to 3.97x acceleration.
tldr_zh: DVG-WM 将世界模型解耦为动力学学习和视觉合成，实现了高效的机器人操作视频预测，速度提升高达 3.97 倍。
summary_zh: 基于视频的具身世界模型通过预测未来状态为机器人操作提供了有吸引力的基础，然而当前方法仍受限于一个根本性的纠缠问题：精确建模动力学通常需要低层级的时间推理，而生成高分辨率帧则需要根据高层语义进行大规模视觉合成。这种纠缠导致迭代规划时推理速度缓慢，或者预测过于粗糙而无法保留富含接触的细节。为解决这一困境，我们提出了解耦视频生成世界模型（DVG-WM），这是一个高效框架，将世界建模明确分解为动力学学习与视觉合成。基于初始观测和语言指令，该模型首先生成一组合理的中间视觉状态序列以预览物理交互，并通过优化获得高保真视频。此外，我们提出了一种高效级联机制：DVG-WM利用流匹配将动力学直接映射到视频潜在空间，并引入潜在退化机制以再生富含接触的细节。在LIBERO及真实世界平台上的实验表明，视频质量得以提升，同时加速比高达3.97倍，验证了解耦视频生成可作为机器人操作的高效具身世界模型。

title: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Reward design remains a central bottleneck for autonomous robot policy improvement, especially in long-horizon manipulation tasks where sparse success labels provide too little signal and binary preferences collapse many competing notions of quality into one ambiguous signal. We introduce Freeform Preference Learning (FPL), a method for learning robot policies from freeform human preferences. Rather than asking annotators which of two trajectories is better overall, FPL lets them define natural-language preference axes, such as speed, safety, quality of placement, or carefulness, and provide pairwise preferences along each axis. These annotations are used to learn a language-conditioned reward model that maps a trajectory and preference label to an axis-specific reward. We use this model to train a reward-conditioned policy that optimizes across the multiple human-specified dimensions. Across four real-world and two simulated long-horizon manipulation tasks, FPL improves over sparse-reward and binary-preference methods by 38 percentage points. Beyond improved performance, FPL learns dense progress signals without explicit subtask segmentation, shows compositionality of behavior not present in the data, and allows users to steer the policy towards different behaviors at test time without retraining. Blog post with videos available at https://freeform-pl.github.io/fpl.website/
tldr: Introduces Freeform Preference Learning (FPL), a method that learns language-conditioned reward models from natural-language preference axes to train reward-conditioned policies for long-horizon robotic manipulation, significantly outperforming sparse-reward and binary-preference baselines.
tldr_zh: 提出了自由形式偏好学习（FPL），通过从自然语言偏好轴学习语言条件奖励模型来训练奖励条件策略，用于长时间跨度的机器人操作任务，显著优于稀疏奖励和二元偏好基线方法。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
奖励设计仍是自主机器人策略改进的核心瓶颈，尤其是在长时域操作任务中——稀疏的成功标签提供的信号过于微弱，而二元偏好则将多种相互竞争的质量指标坍缩为一个模糊的信号。我们提出**自由形式偏好学习（FPL）**，一种从自由形式的人类偏好中学习机器人策略的方法。FPL 不要求标注者判断两条轨迹整体上孰优孰劣，而是允许他们定义自然语言偏好轴（如速度、安全性、放置质量或细致程度），并沿每个轴提供成对偏好。这些标注用于学习一个语言条件奖励模型，该模型将轨迹与偏好标签映射为特定轴上的奖励。我们利用该模型训练奖励条件策略，使其在多个人类指定的维度上进行优化。在四项真实世界和两项模拟的长时域操作任务中，FPL 相比稀疏奖励和二元偏好方法提升了 38 个百分点。除了性能提升外，FPL 无需显式子任务分割即可学习密集的进度信号，展现出数据中未曾出现的行为组合性，并允许用户在测试时无需重新训练即可引导策略朝向不同行为。附有视频的博客页面请访问：https://freeform-pl.github.io/fpl.website。

title: Human-as-Humanoid: Enabling Zero-Shot Humanoid Learning from Ego-Exo Human Videos with Human-Aligned Embodiments
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models across robot embodiments require high-quality observation--action supervision to learn deployable action distributions, yet scaling such robot data remains difficult, especially for high-DoF humanoids. Teleoperation provides controller-aligned supervision, while human egocentric videos capture diverse bimanual manipulation but do not directly provide executable robot actions. We introduce Human-as-Humanoid, a human-to-humanoid supervision framework that enables near-real-time human-centric action generation, making human demonstrations usable for high-DoF humanoid VLA training by jointly aligning the robot embodiment, the sensing setup, and the action-label interface. Built on PrimeU, a human-aligned 60-DoF upper-body humanoid, Human-as-Humanoid uses synchronized ego-exo videos to pair deployment-aligned egocentric observations with exocentric motion recovery, retargets the recovered human motion through staged Inverse Kinematics (IK) into controller-aligned 60-DoF action chunks, and trains the VLA model with Forward Kinematics (FK)-aware supervision to preserve wrist and fingertip task-space geometry. This converts large-scale human demonstrations from visual observations into executable observation--action supervision for the target humanoid. Experiments validate the conversion chain at the motion-recovery, robot-action-space, and real-robot deployment levels. Human-as-Humanoid yields a 4.8--7.2x raw demonstration-throughput gain over humanoid teleoperation in our data-collection analysis, and on several downstream tasks, policies post-trained only with the converted human labels generalize to real-robot deployment without target-task robot demonstrations. The official project website is available at https://zgc-embodyai.github.io/Human-as-Humanoid.
tldr: Proposes a framework to convert large-scale human ego-exo video demonstrations into executable observation-action supervision for high-DoF humanoid VLA training, enabling zero-shot humanoid learning without target-task robot demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 提出一个框架将大规模人类第一人称视角视频演示转化为高自由度人形机器人可执行的观测-动作监督，无需目标任务机器人演示即可实现零样本人形机器人学习。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
跨机器人本体的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要高质量的观测-动作监督来学习可部署的动作分布，然而大规模采集此类机器人数据仍面临困难，对于高自由度人形机器人尤其如此。遥操作可提供与控制器对齐的监督，而人类第一视角视频虽然能捕捉丰富的双臂操作行为，但无法直接提供可执行的机器人动作。我们提出“人即人形机器人”（Human-as-Humanoid）这一人-人形机器人监督框架，通过联合对齐机器人本体、感知设置与动作标签接口，实现近实时的人为中心动作生成，使人类演示可用于高自由度人形机器人的VLA训练。该框架基于PrimeU——一个与人类对齐的60自由度上半身人形机器人，利用同步的第一视角与第三视角视频，将部署对齐的第一视角观测与第三视角运动恢复进行配对；通过分阶段逆运动学（IK）将恢复的人类运动重定向为与控制器对齐的60自由度动作块；并采用正运动学（FK）感知的监督来训练VLA模型，以保留手腕与指尖的任务空间几何结构。由此，该方法将大规模人类演示从视觉观测转化为目标人形机器人可执行的观测-动作监督。实验在运动恢复、机器人动作空间和实际机器人部署三个层面验证了这一转换链的有效性。在我们的数据采集分析中，“人即人形机器人”相较于传统遥操作实现了4.8至7.2倍的原始演示吞吐量提升；在多个下游任务中，仅使用转换后的人类标签进行后训练的策略，即可泛化至实际机器人部署，而无需目标任务的机器人演示。官方项目网站见：https://zgc-embodyai.github.io/Human-as-Humanoid。

title: OopsieVerse: A Safety Benchmark with Damage-Aware Simulation for Robot Manipulation
summary: While robotic manipulation capabilities have advanced rapidly, physical safety remains a major barrier to deploying household robots: task success is insufficient if the robot damages itself or its surroundings. Simulation offers a harm-free alternative to costly and dangerous real-world training and evaluation, yet existing simulators lack general mechanisms to detect, quantify, and represent damage. To address this gap, we introduce OOPSIEVERSE, a unified simulation framework and benchmark for damage-aware household manipulation. OOPSIEVERSE provides damage as an explicit, physically-grounded, and taskagnostic signal by converting sources such as contact forces, temperature changes, and liquid interactions into corresponding mechanical, thermal or fluid damage. OOPSIEVERSE comprises two core elements: (1) DAMAGESIM, a simulator-agnostic framework for detecting and quantifying damage during navigation and manipulation, and (2) a suite of household tasks designed to evaluate common damage modes and distinguish between task completion and safe execution. We demonstrate the generality of our framework by instantiating DAMAGESIM in two simulators with different physics backends, OmniGibson (Nvidia Omniverse) and RoboCasa (MuJoCo). We further showcase the utility of OOPSIEVERSE across multiple use cases, including (1) guiding safer demonstration collection via real-time damage feedback, (2) learning safer manipulation policies through damage-conditioned imitation learning and reinforcement learning, (3) benchmarking the safety of state-of-the-art Vision Language Action policies, and (4) improving real-world safety of sim-to-real transferred policies. Together, our results highlight the potential of OOPSIEVERSE as an open-source foundation for systematic, scalable research on safe robot manipulation. For code and more information, please refer to https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsieverse/
tldr: This paper introduces OopsieVerse, a simulation framework and benchmark for damage-aware household robot manipulation, enabling detection and quantification of physical damage for safer policy learning and evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了OopsieVerse，一个用于家庭机器人操作的安全仿真框架和基准，能够检测和量化物理损伤，以支持更安全的策略学习和评估。
summary_zh: 尽管机器人操作能力取得了快速进展，但物理安全性仍是家用机器人部署的主要障碍：如果机器人损坏自身或其周围环境，任务成功便不足以衡量其表现。仿真为成本高昂且危险的真实世界训练与评估提供了一种无风险的替代方案，然而现有仿真器缺乏检测、量化及表征损伤的通用机制。为解决这一空白，我们提出OOPSIEVERSE——一个统一的损伤感知家用操作仿真框架与基准测试平台。OOPSIEVERSE将接触力、温度变化及液体交互等来源转化为相应的机械、热力或流体损伤，从而将损伤作为显式、基于物理且与任务无关的信号提供。该框架包含两个核心要素：（1）DAMAGESIM——一个与仿真器无关的框架，用于在导航与操作过程中检测和量化损伤；（2）一套旨在评估常见损伤模式并区分任务完成与安全执行的家用操作任务集。我们通过在两个具有不同物理引擎的仿真器（基于Nvidia Omniverse的OmniGibson和基于MuJoCo的RoboCasa）中实例化DAMAGESIM，证明了框架的通用性。此外，我们在多个用例中展示了OOPSIEVERSE的实用性，包括：(1) 通过实时损伤反馈引导更安全的演示采集；(2) 通过基于损伤条件的模仿学习与强化学习习得更安全的操作策略；(3) 对最先进的视觉语言动作策略进行安全性基准测试；(4) 提升从仿真到现实迁移策略的实际安全性。综合来看，我们的结果突显了OOPSIEVERSE作为系统性、可扩展的安全机器人操作研究开源基础的潜力。代码及更多信息请参见：https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsieverse/

title: LeCropFollow: Latent Space Planning for Navigation in Unstructured Crop Fields
summary: Unstructured navigational features, such as irregular planting or discontinuities, remain the primary failure mode for under-canopy agricultural robots. Existing geometric approaches often fail in these scenarios because they compress high-dimensional visual data into deterministic spatial references, effectively discarding the uncertainty and semantic context required to navigate ambiguous terrain. To address this, we present LeCropFollow, a visual navigation framework that bypasses explicit geometric modeling in favor of a learned latent representation. By integrating a self-supervised semantic heatmap extractor with TD-MPC2, a Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) planner, our system optimizes trajectories directly within a latent manifold. The framework operates over the uncompressed heatmap signal, preserving the semantic context that geometric reductions discard. We demonstrate that this representational shift enables zero-shot transfer from simplified simulation to the physical world without fine-tuning. Extensive field experiments in late-stage corn fields show that LeCropFollow matches state-of-the-art baselines in unstructured rows but significantly outperforms them in plantation gaps, achieving a 2.4x reduction in semantic failures compared to keypoint-based methods. These results suggest that latent planning offers a robust alternative to geometric estimation for operations in heterogeneous agricultural environments. Code, models, and data available: https://felipe-tommaselli.github.io/lecropfollow .
tldr: LeCropFollow uses a learned latent representation and model-based RL (TD-MPC2) to plan navigation trajectories in unstructured crop fields, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and significantly reducing semantic failures in plantation gaps compared to geometric methods.
tldr_zh: LeCropFollow利用学习到的潜在表示和基于模型的强化学习（TD-MPC2）在非结构化农田中规划导航轨迹，实现了从仿真到现实的零样本迁移，并在种植间隙中相比几何方法显著减少了语义故障。
summary_zh: 非结构化导航特征（如不规则种植或间断区域）仍是冠层下农业机器人面临的主要故障模式。现有几何方法常在这些场景中失效，因为它们将高维视觉数据压缩为确定性空间参考，实质丢弃了在模糊地形中导航所需的不确定性与语义上下文。针对这一问题，我们提出LeCropFollow——一种绕过显式几何建模、转而采用学习型潜在表征的视觉导航框架。通过将自监督语义热图提取器与基于模型的强化学习规划器TD-MPC2相集成，本系统直接在潜在流形中优化轨迹。该框架对未压缩的热图信号进行运算，保留了被几何约简所丢弃的语义上下文。我们证明这种表征转换能够实现从简化仿真到真实物理世界的零样本迁移，无需额外微调。在晚季玉米田中的大量田间实验表明：LeCropFollow在非结构化行间区域达到与现有最优基线相当的性能，但在种植间隙区域显著超越它们，相比基于关键点的方法实现了2.4倍的语义故障减少。这些结果表明，针对异质农业环境中的作业任务，潜在空间规划为几何估计提供了稳健的替代方案。代码、模型及数据见：https://felipe-tommaselli.github.io/lecropfollow

title: Learning Locomotion on Discrete Terrain via Minimal Proximity Sensing
summary: Learning-based control has revolutionized dynamic locomotion, yet navigating unstructured terrain remains limited by a robot's incomplete awareness of imminent ground contact. While global perception systems such as LiDARs and depth cameras provide environmental context, they are frequently plagued by latencies, occlusions, and the high computational cost of dense geometric reconstruction. On the other hand, proprioceptive feedback is purely reactive, initiating corrections only after impact has occurred. This work explores embedding a minimal suite of low-cost, high-frequency infrared proximity sensors directly into the feet of a quadrupedal robot. These sensors provide "pre-contact" feedback that is robust to self-occlusions and significantly less computationally demanding than conventional vision-based pipelines. By integrating these localized signals into a reinforcement learning framework, we enable the robot to anticipate terrain discontinuities such as gaps and stepping stones that are problematic for traditional perception stacks due to occlusions or state estimation drift. We demonstrate that such sparse, near-field sensing can be reliably modeled in simulation and transferred to the real world with high fidelity. Experimental results show that local proximity sensing substantially improves traversal robustness over discrete terrain and offers a low-power, low-latency alternative or complement to complex global perception suites in unpredictable environments. For more information about results and methods, please see the project website: https://sites.google.com/view/foot-tof/home.
tldr: This paper introduces low-cost infrared proximity sensors on a quadruped's feet to provide pre-contact terrain feedback, improving locomotion over discrete gaps and stepping stones via reinforcement learning and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文在四足机器人足部嵌入低成本红外接近传感器，提供预接触地形反馈，结合强化学习与仿真到现实的迁移，提升了跨越离散间隙和踏脚石等复杂地形的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 基于学习的控制方法已彻底改变了动态运动领域，但在非结构化地形中导航仍受限于机器人对即将发生的地面接触的不完全感知能力。尽管激光雷达与深度相机等全局感知系统能提供环境背景信息，但它们常受延迟、遮挡以及密集几何重构带来的高计算成本困扰。另一方面，本体感觉反馈完全是被动的，只能在接触发生后触发修正。本研究探索在四足机器人足部直接嵌入一套微型低成本、高频红外接近传感器。这些传感器能提供"预接触"反馈，对自遮挡具有鲁棒性，且计算需求远低于传统视觉处理管线。通过将这些局部信号集成到强化学习框架中，我们使机器人能够预测地形不连续特征（如间隙和垫脚石），这些特征常因遮挡或状态估计漂移而难以被传统感知系统处理。研究证明，这种稀疏的近场感知可在仿真中可靠建模，并高保真度迁移至现实世界。实验结果表明，局部接近传感显著提升了离散地形的穿越鲁棒性，为复杂全局感知系统在不可预测环境中提供了低功耗、低延迟的替代或补充方案。有关方法与结果的更多信息，请访问项目网站：https://sites.google.com/view/foot-tof/home。

title: CoDex: Learning Compositional Dexterous Functional Manipulation without Demonstrations
summary: In this work, we study Compositional Dexterous Functional Object Manipulation (CD-FOM): tasks such as aiming and actuating a spray bottle on a plant or a glue gun on wood, which require both actuating an object's internal mechanism and controlling its pose to apply the object's function to the environment. These tasks pose significant challenges for robots due to the demanding integration of semantic understanding of the object's function, actuation mode, and application area with intricate physical dexterity to manage grasp stability, movement trajectory, and actuation. We introduce CoDex, a zero-demonstration framework that autonomously discovers CD-FOM manipulation strategies. CoDex uses vision-language models (VLMs) to infer semantic constraints from the task and scene. These constraints guide analytic constrained optimization to generate a short list of functional grasp candidates that can be efficiently refined with reinforcement learning to generate full grasp-move-actuate policies transferable from simulation to the real world. We evaluate CoDex on a 7-DoF robot arm with a 16-DoF multi-fingered hand across six CD-FOM tasks involving previously unseen objects with internal mechanisms, including spray bottles, hot glue guns, air dusters, flashlights, and pepper grinders, and their application to unseen target objects, showcasing its ability to autonomously discover and execute complex, physically viable dexterous behaviors without human demonstrations. More information at https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/CoDex/.
tldr: CoDex is a zero-demonstration framework that uses VLMs and constrained optimization combined with reinforcement learning to enable a robot arm with a multi-fingered hand to perform compositional dexterous functional manipulation tasks like spraying or gluing.
tldr_zh: CoDex是一个无需演示的框架，结合视觉-语言模型、约束优化和强化学习，使机械臂和多指手能够自主完成喷洒、涂胶等组合灵巧功能操作。
summary_zh: 在本工作中，我们研究了组合式灵巧功能性物体操纵（CD-FOM）：诸如对植物上的喷雾瓶或木材上的热胶枪进行瞄准与致动等任务，这些任务既需要启动物体的内部机构，又需要控制其姿态以将物体功能施加于环境。由于需将物体功能的语义理解、致动模式及应用区域，与用以管理抓取稳定性、运动轨迹和致动的复杂物理灵巧性进行高度整合，这类任务给机器人带来了重大挑战。我们提出CoDex——一种零示教框架，能够自主发现CD-FOM操纵策略。CoDex利用视觉语言模型（VLM）从任务与场景中推断语义约束，这些约束引导分析性约束优化生成少量功能性抓取候选，并通过强化学习高效优化，最终生成可自仿真迁移至现实世界的完整“抓取-移动-致动”策略。我们在配备16自由度多指手部的7自由度机器人臂上，针对六项CD-FOM任务评估了CoDex，这些任务涉及含内部机构的未见物体（包括喷雾瓶、热胶枪、气枪、手电筒及胡椒研磨机）及其对未见目标物体的应用，展示了其无需人类示教即可自主发现并执行复杂、物理可行的灵巧行为能力。更多信息请访问https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/CoDex/。

title: Bridging Local Observation and Global Simulation in Closed-Loop Traffic Modeling
summary: A local-to-global context mismatch arises when autoregressive traffic simulators trained on ego-centric driving logs are deployed in globally observable closed-loop environments. In such logs, the ego vehicle has rich local observations, while surrounding agents are only partially observed due to perception limits and occlusions. As a result, simulators may learn incomplete context--action mappings that remain hidden in log-based training but emerge during closed-loop rollouts, leading to unrealistic behaviors such as abnormal stops, unsafe interactions, and rule violations. We propose CRAFT, a Contextual pReference Alignment Framework for Traffic Simulation, to mitigate this mismatch via self-supervised failure discovery and preference-guided test-time alignment. CRAFT treats the base simulator as a globally observable sandbox, generating diverse what-if rollouts from logged initial states to expose context-induced failures. These failures are grounded with human-aligned driving priors and converted into preference supervision for training a Contextual Preference Evaluator (CPE). At inference time, CPE acts as a plug-in alignment module that scores candidate actions under complete scene context and reweights autoregressive decoding toward globally coherent behaviors. CRAFT mitigates this local-to-global contextual bias, reducing collisions by 31.2\% and traffic violations by 33.2\% without retraining the base simulator.
tldr: CRAFT mitigates the local-to-global context mismatch in closed-loop traffic simulation by using self-supervised failure discovery and a plug-in preference evaluator to reweight actions, reducing collisions and traffic violations without retraining the base simulator.
tldr_zh: CRAFT通过自监督故障发现和即插即用的偏好评估器来重新加权动作，缓解了闭环交通模拟中的局部到全局上下文不匹配问题，在不重新训练基础模拟器的情况下减少了碰撞和交通违规。
summary_zh: 局部到全局的上下文不匹配问题，源于基于自我中心驾驶日志训练的自回归交通模拟器在全局可观测的闭环环境中部署时产生。在此类日志中，自车拥有丰富的局部观测，而周围智能体因感知限制和遮挡仅被部分观测。因此，模拟器可能学习到不完整的上下文-动作映射，这些映射在基于日志的训练中保持隐藏，但在闭环推演中显现，导致异常停车、不安全交互和违反规则等非真实行为。我们提出CRAFT——一种用于交通模拟的上下文偏好对齐框架，通过自监督故障发现和偏好引导的测试时对齐来缓解这一不匹配问题。CRAFT将基础模拟器视为全局可观测沙盒，从记录的初始状态生成多样化的假设推演，以暴露上下文引发的故障。这些故障通过人类对齐的驾驶先验进行夯实，并转化为偏好监督，用于训练上下文偏好评估器（CPE）。在推理时，CPE作为即插即用的对齐模块，在完整场景上下文中对候选动作进行评分，并重新加权自回归解码，使其趋向全局连贯行为。CRAFT缓解了这种局部到全局的上下文偏差，在不重新训练基础模拟器的情况下，将碰撞率降低31.2%，交通违规率降低33.2%。

title: RoboTacDex: A Dexterous Visual-Tactile-Action Dataset for Humanoid Manipulation
summary:
In the field of robot learning, large-scale and diverse demonstration trajectories provide the fundamental basis for enhancing robotic manipulation ability. We introduce RoboTacDex, a large, multi-modal, and diverse dataset of dexterous manipulation behaviors performed with a humanoid robot. Built on the publicly accessible humanoid robot Unitree G1, RoboTacDex consists of 6k trajectories covering 19 tasks, 23 skills, and interactions with 22 objects. RoboTacDex provides comprehensive records including multi-view RGB and depth information, tactile feedback, and detailed semantic annotations. Furthermore, the dataset features a variety of relatively challenging tasks that can only be completed by dual arms and dexterous hands, aiming to mimic human-like operational logic and simulate real-world manipulation complexity. To ensure data collection quality, we develop an improved multi-camera synchronization system to enable millisecond data synchronization and recording of modalities. In our experiments, we evaluate three representative imitation learning models on our dataset,
  analyzing their performance as well as their respective strengths and limitations across different task categories. Successful trial results and a moderate level of generalization capabilities across a suite of tasks indicate the effectiveness and diversity of the collected dataset. Our dataset will be open-sourced soon.
tldr: This paper presents a large-scale, multi-modal dataset of dexterous humanoid manipulation trajectories, including vision, tactile, and action data across 19 tasks, to support imitation learning and robot foundation model research.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个大规模、多模态的灵巧人形操作数据集，包含视觉、触觉和动作数据，覆盖19个任务，旨在支持模仿学习和机器人基础模型研究。
summary_zh: 在机器人学习领域，大规模且多样化的示教轨迹为提升机器人操作能力提供了基础支撑。我们提出RoboTacDex——一个大规模、多模态、多样化的类人机器人灵巧操作行为数据集。该数据集基于公开可访问的仿人机器人Unitree G1构建，包含6000条轨迹，覆盖19项任务、23种技能以及与22个物体的交互。RoboTacDex提供了包括多视角RGB与深度信息、触觉反馈及详细语义标注在内的全面记录。此外，该数据集包含一系列仅能通过双臂与灵巧手完成的相对高难度任务，旨在模拟类人操作逻辑并再现真实世界的操作复杂度。为确保数据采集质量，我们开发了改进的多相机同步系统，实现了毫秒级数据同步与多模态记录。在实验中，我们基于该数据集评估了三种代表性模仿学习模型，分析了它们在不同任务类别上的性能表现及各自的优势与局限。实验成功结果及任务套件中展现的适度泛化能力，验证了所收集数据集的有效性与多样性。该数据集即将开源。

title: PriorEye: Geospatial Visual Priors for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Most end-to-end autonomous driving methods rely solely on instantaneous sensor observations, limiting them to reactive behavior without the anticipatory foresight human drivers employ through prior experience. We introduce geospatial visual priors, street-level visual context anchored to the intended driving route, providing visual-spatial foresight independent of real-time sensors. We propose a memory augmentation module featuring a dual-memory architecture and an adaptive memory gate, which can be easily integrated into existing end-to-end approaches. This design pairs a contextual memory for retrieved priors with a persistent fallback memory, and dynamically regulates the influence of memories based on current state compatibility. Evaluated on the NAVSIM-v2 benchmark, our approach consistently improves performance across diverse end-to-end baselines. Furthermore, because these priors are independent of onboard sensors, our method inherently improves robustness against sensor corruption, while the dual-memory design ensures safe fallback when the retrieved priors themselves become unreliable. Our project page is available at https://ori-mrg.github.io/PriorEye.
tldr: Introduces geospatial visual priors for end-to-end autonomous driving, enabling anticipatory foresight via a dual-memory module that improves robustness and performance on NAVSIM-v2.
tldr_zh: 提出地理空间视觉先验知识增强端到端自动驾驶，通过双记忆模块提供预测性视觉先见，在NAVSIM-v2上提升性能与鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 大多数端到端自动驾驶方法仅依赖瞬时传感器观测，使其局限于反应式行为，而缺乏人类驾驶员通过先验经验所具备的预期性前瞻能力。我们引入地理空间视觉先验——锚定于预期驾驶路径的街景级视觉上下文，从而提供独立于实时传感器的视觉-空间前瞻能力。我们提出一种内存增强模块，其采用双内存架构与自适应内存门控机制，可轻松集成至现有端到端方法中。该设计将用于检索先验的上下文内存与持久性后备内存配对，并根据当前状态兼容性动态调节内存的影响。在NAVSIM-v2基准测试上的评估表明，我们的方法在多种端到端基线模型上均能持续提升性能。此外，由于这些先验独立于车载传感器，我们的方法本质上增强了对传感器损坏的鲁棒性，而双内存设计则确保在检索到的先验本身不可靠时提供安全的后备方案。项目页面请访问 https://ori-mrg.github.io/PriorEye。

title: UniTacVLA: Unified Tactile Understanding and Prediction in Vision Language Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in many robotic manipulation tasks, yet remain limited in contact-rich dexterous manipulation. To overcome this limitation, recent vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) methods incorporate tactile sensing into VLA models to provide direct contact information. However, they typically treat tactile signals as passive auxiliary inputs, making it difficult to model tactile semantics and future physical interactions. To this end, we propose a unified tactile learning framework for contact-rich manipulation that models tactile signals as dynamic interaction cues for both contact understanding and prediction. Specifically, we construct a unified tactile latent space and jointly model current tactile states and future contact changes through tactile chain-of-thought reasoning and coarse-to-fine future tactile prediction, thereby forming a state-aware and dynamics-aware tactile prior. Based on this prior, we introduce a tactile-action mixed controller that combines real-time and predicted tactile feedback to refine low-frequency action chunks with high-frequency corrections. Real-world experiments on four categories of contact-rich tasks, including adjustment, insertion, wiping, and assembly, under both clean and externally perturbed settings, show that our method improves success rate, manipulation accuracy, and contact robustness over existing methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in dexterous physical interaction.
tldr: UniTacVLA unifies tactile sensing into VLA models by constructing a tactile latent space with chain-of-thought reasoning and future contact prediction, enabling dexterous manipulation with high-frequency corrective actions.
tldr_zh: UniTacVLA通过构建触觉潜在空间和链式推理及未来接触预测，将触觉感知统一到VLA模型中，实现了灵巧操作中的高频修正动作。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在多种机器人操作任务中表现出色，但在高接触灵巧操作方面仍存在局限。为克服这一限制，近期视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）方法将触觉感知引入VLA模型以提供直接接触信息。然而，这类方法通常将触觉信号视为被动辅助输入，难以建模触觉语义与未来物理交互。为此，我们提出一种面向高接触操作的统一触觉学习框架，将触觉信号建模为用于接触理解与预测的动态交互线索。具体而言，我们构建了统一的触觉隐空间，通过触觉链式推理与由粗到精的未来触觉预测，联合建模当前触觉状态与未来接触变化，从而形成兼具状态感知与动力学感知的触觉先验。基于该先验，我们提出触觉-动作混合控制器，结合实时触觉反馈与预测触觉反馈，以高频修正优化低频动作块。在包含调整、插入、擦拭、装配四类高接触任务的真实机器人实验中，无论处于清洁环境还是外部扰动条件下，我们的方法均能提升成功率、操作精度与接触鲁棒性，优于现有方法，证明了其在灵巧物理交互中的有效性。

title: FastDSAC: Enhancing Policy Plasticity via Constrained Exploration for Scalable Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Scalable reinforcement learning has popularized high-throughput sampling architectures, which significantly compresses the training time for off-policy methods in robotic locomotion. However, the rapid increase of data volume and update frequency undermines the stability of value-based methods and diminishes the plasticity of policy networks. To address these challenges, this work presents FastDSAC, a fast and high-performance variant of the Distributional Actor-Critic algorithm designed for parallel sampling scenarios. Specifically, we introduce a truncated Gaussian distribution to approximate the learned policy, which effectively excludes out-of-distribution actions that strain target value estimation while keeping necessary stochasticity for exploration. The proposed action constraint functions as an implicit regularization, which counteracts the plasticity loss typically caused by aggressive gradient updates. This preservation of network adaptability enhances sample efficiency, particularly in scenarios with a high update-to-data ratio, and accelerates the early training process. In contrast to prior fast reinforcement learning approaches that rely on discrete value distributions, our method utilizes a continuous Gaussian representation equipped with adaptive variance regulation, which improves value estimation accuracy by sampling confident and informative transitions. Extensive experiments on MuJoCo Playground and HumanoidBench demonstrate that FastDSAC not only stabilizes the overall training process but also achieves superior asymptotic performance and faster convergence compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr: FastDSAC enhances policy plasticity and training stability in high-throughput off-policy RL for humanoid locomotion by constraining action sampling via a truncated Gaussian distribution, achieving faster convergence and superior performance on MuJoCo Playground and HumanoidBench.
tldr_zh: FastDSAC通过截断高斯分布约束动作采样，增强了高吞吐量离策略RL在类人运动中的策略可塑性和训练稳定性，在MuJoCo Playground和HumanoidBench上实现了更快的收敛和更优的性能。
summary_zh: 可扩展强化学习推动了高吞吐量采样架构的普及，这显著压缩了机器人运动控制中离策略方法的训练时间。然而，数据量的快速增长与更新频率的提升削弱了基于值方法的稳定性，并降低了策略网络的可塑性。为解决这些问题，本文提出FastDSAC——一种专为并行采样场景设计的高性能分布式演员-评论家算法变体。具体而言，我们引入截断高斯分布来近似学习策略，该分布有效排除会扭曲目标值估计的分布外动作，同时保留探索所需的必要随机性。所提出的动作约束作为隐式正则化机制运行，能够抵消激进梯度更新通常导致的可塑性损失。这种网络适应性的保持提升了样本效率，特别是在高更新-数据比场景中，并加速了早期训练过程。与依赖离散值分布的先前快速强化学习方法不同，我们采用了配备自适应方差调节的连续高斯表征方法，通过采样高置信度且信息丰富的转移样本来提升值估计精度。在MuJoCo Playground和HumanoidBench上的大量实验表明，相较于现有最优基线方法，FastDSAC不仅稳定了整体训练过程，还实现了更优的渐近性能和更快的收敛速度。

title: HABIT: Human-Aware Behavior and Interaction Training Dataset for Robot Manipulation
summary: Large-scale demonstration datasets have been central to recent progress in general-purpose robot policies. However, existing datasets are collected in human-absent settings, and policies trained on such data may perform tasks competently in isolation but fail to exhibit human-aware behaviors. To address this gap, we introduce HABIT, a large-scale robot demonstration dataset for human-present environments. We organize tasks into three roles capturing distinct modes of human-robot interaction: Collaborator, where human and robot jointly accomplish a task; Coworker, where they pursue separate tasks in a shared space; and Supervisor, where the human directs the robot. The dataset comprises over 10K episodes and over 160 hours across 60 tasks. Our experiments show that training on human-present data elicits human-aware behaviors that robot-only data fails to produce: spatiotemporal synchronization in Collaborator tasks, yielding in Coworker tasks, and gesture grounding in Supervisor tasks. Moreover, training on HABIT enables rapid adaptation to new human-robot interaction tasks. By introducing human presence as a new axis of dataset diversity, HABIT extends robot policies to environments shared with humans.
tldr: HABIT is a large-scale robot manipulation dataset collected in human-present environments, enabling policies to learn human-aware behaviors like collaboration, yielding, and gesture grounding that are absent from robot-only datasets.
tldr_zh: HABIT是一个在有人环境中收集的大规模机器人操作数据集，使策略能够学习协作、避让和手势理解等人类感知行为，而这些行为在仅含机器人的数据集中无法获得。
summary_zh: 大规模演示数据集在通用型机器人策略的最新进展中发挥了核心作用。然而，现有数据集均在无人类环境中采集，据此训练的机器人策略虽能独立完成任务，却无法展现具备人类感知意识的行为。为填补这一空白，我们提出HABIT——一个面向人类在场环境的大规模机器人演示数据集。我们将任务组织为三种角色，分别对应人机交互的不同模式：协作者模式（人与机器人协同完成任务）、共事者模式（双方在共享空间中执行独立任务）以及监督者模式（人类指挥机器人行动）。该数据集涵盖60项任务，包含超过1万条演示片段与160小时时长。实验表明，基于人类在场数据训练的策略能产生仅依赖机器人数据无法实现的人类感知行为：协作者任务中的时空同步、共事者任务中的礼让行为，以及监督者任务中的手势指令理解。此外，基于HABIT的训练可快速适应新兴人机交互任务。通过将人类存在作为数据集多样性的新维度，HABIT将机器人策略的应用范围扩展至与人类共享的环境。

title: DynFly: Dynamic-Aware Continuous Trajectory Generation for UAV Vision-Language Navigation in Urban Environments
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large models have significantly improved UAV vision-language navigation (UAV-VLN) by enhancing high-level perception and reasoning. However, existing methods mainly focus on predicting discrete actions, local targets, or sparse waypoints, while the continuous transition from navigation intent to executable UAV motion remains weakly modeled. This motion-interface gap limits the continuity, stability, and executability of generated UAV trajectories. To address this gap, we propose DynFly, a dynamic-aware continuous trajectory generation framework that bridges high-level navigation reasoning and executable UAV motion. DynFly bridges high-level navigation intent and continuous UAV motion through a lightweight trajectory generation layer. Specifically, it represents expert trajectories in B-spline control-point space and employs a Spline-DiT generator to learn conditional trajectory generation via flow matching. Furthermore, we introduce UAV-oriented dynamic-aware supervision over position, finite-difference velocity, finite-difference acceleration, heading consistency, and local target alignment, enabling the generated trajectories to better satisfy UAV motion characteristics. And our trajectory generation framework can also be integrated with an existing UAV-VLN framework while preserving its original visual-language reasoning pipeline. Extensive experiments on the OpenUAV UAV-VLN benchmark show that DynFly improves both navigation performance and trajectory quality. On the Test Unseen Full split, DynFly improves the strongest baseline by 4.69 NDTW, 2.40 SDTW, 2.14 SR points and 4.87 OSR points, while reducing NE by 4.51 m.
tldr: DynFly bridges high-level navigation reasoning and executable UAV motion by generating continuous trajectories in B-spline control-point space using a Spline-DiT generator with dynamic-aware supervision, improving both navigation performance and trajectory quality on the OpenUAV UAV-VLN benchmark.
tldr_zh: DynFly 通过在 B 样条控制点空间中生成连续轨迹，并使用 Spline-DiT 生成器结合动态感知监督，弥合了高层导航推理与可执行无人机运动之间的鸿沟，在 OpenUAV UAV-VLN 基准上提升了导航性能和轨迹质量。
summary_zh: 多模态大模型的最新进展通过增强高层感知与推理能力，显著提升了无人机视觉-语言导航（UAV-VLN）性能。然而，现有方法主要聚焦于预测离散动作、局部目标或稀疏航点，而对从导航意图到可执行无人机运动之间的连续转换建模仍较薄弱。这种运动接口的缺失限制了所生成无人机轨迹的连续性、稳定性与可执行性。为弥补这一不足，我们提出DynFly——一种动态感知的连续轨迹生成框架，该框架能够衔接高层导航推理与可执行无人机运动。DynFly通过轻量级轨迹生成层将高层导航意图与连续无人机运动桥接起来。具体而言，它将专家轨迹表示为B样条控制点空间，并采用Spline-DiT生成器通过流匹配学习条件轨迹生成。此外，我们引入了面向无人机的动态感知监督机制，涵盖位置、有限差分速度、有限差分加速度、航向一致性及局部目标对齐，使生成的轨迹更契合无人机运动特性。该轨迹生成框架还可与现有UAV-VLN框架集成，同时保留其原有的视觉-语言推理流程。在OpenUAV无人机视觉-语言导航基准上的大量实验表明，DynFly既提升了导航性能又改善了轨迹质量。在Test Unseen Full测试集上，DynFly将最强基线提升了4.69 NDTW、2.40 SDTW、2.14 SR点与4.87 OSR点，同时将NE降低了4.51米。

title: ChronoFlow-Policy: Unifying Past-Current-Future Interaction Flow in Visuomotor Policy Learning
summary: Visual signals play a crucial role in policy learning by enabling models to capture object motion and interaction dynamics. Just as humans reason about actions using both past experience and anticipated outcomes, effective policies should integrate past interactions with future predictions. However, existing visuomotor policies typically model either historical context or future dynamics in isolation, lacking a unified temporal representation of interaction dynamics. In this work, we introduce \textbf{ChronoFlow}, a temporally unified representation that captures \textbf{past, current, and future} interaction dynamics through sparse 3D keypoints of both objects and the gripper. Based on this representation, we propose \textbf{ChronoFlow-Policy}, a diffusion-based visuomotor policy that jointly learns ChronoFlow and action sequences through a co-training objective. Experiments on 14 simulated tasks and 5 real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that ChronoFlow-Policy consistently outperforms strong diffusion-policy baselines and improves robustness in long-horizon and non-Markovian manipulation scenarios.
tldr: ChronoFlow-Policy unifies past, current, and future interaction dynamics via sparse 3D keypoints and a diffusion-based visuomotor policy, achieving robust manipulation in both simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: ChronoFlow-Policy通过稀疏3D关键点统一过去、现在和未来的交互动态，并基于扩散的视觉运动策略，在仿真和真实操作任务中实现了鲁棒的操控性能。
summary_zh: 视觉信号在策略学习中起着关键作用，使模型能够捕捉物体的运动与交互动态。正如人类同时利用过往经验和预期结果来推理动作一样，有效的策略应当将过去的交互与未来的预测相融合。然而，现有的视觉运动策略通常孤立地建模历史上下文或未来动态，缺乏对交互动态的统一时间表征。在本研究中，我们提出\textbf{ChronoFlow}——一种时间统一的表征，通过物体和夹爪的稀疏3D关键点捕捉\textbf{过去、当前和未来}的交互动态。基于此表征，我们提出\textbf{ChronoFlow-Policy}，一种基于扩散模型的视觉运动策略，通过联合训练目标共同学习ChronoFlow与动作序列。在14个模拟任务和5个真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，ChronoFlow-Policy持续优于强扩散策略基线，并在长时域和非马尔可夫操作场景中展现出更强的鲁棒性。

title: A Large-Language-Model Supported Personalized Driving Framework for Lane Change in Highway Scenarios
summary: Personalized driving can improve the user acceptance of automated driving systems. However, existing methods still provide limited support for translating natural-language driving preferences, especially when such preferences are expressed implicitly, into executable and distinguishable driving behaviors. This paper proposes a large language model (LLM)-supported personalized driving framework for highway lane-change scenarios. The framework maps natural-language driving commands to executable planning parameters in the open-source Apollo automated driving stack according to three driving styles: aggressive, normal, and conservative. To establish this mapping, candidate planning parameters are evaluated based on the resulting lane-change behaviors, and style-specific parameter sets are constructed through clustering and style-intensity ranking. For command interpretation, a retrieval dataset is constructed to support retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enabling LLM-based interpretation of implicit user commands. Experimental results show that the derived parameter sets generate distinguishable personalized lane-change behaviors, while RAG consistently improves preference interpretation, particularly for implicit commands. These results indicate the potential of integrating LLM-based natural-language interaction with Apollo to support personalized lane-change behavior generation. The source code and the relevant datasets are available at: https://github.com/ftgTUGraz/LLM-Personalized-Driving.
tldr: This paper presents an LLM-supported personalized driving framework that maps natural-language commands to lane-change behaviors via style-specific parameter sets and retrieval-augmented generation, validated in Apollo simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种大语言模型支持的个人化驾驶框架，通过风格特定参数集和检索增强生成将自然语言指令映射为变道行为，并在Apollo仿真中验证。
summary_zh: 个性化驾驶能够提升用户对自动驾驶系统的接受度。然而，现有方法在将自然语言驾驶偏好（尤其是隐含表达的偏好）转化为可执行且可区分的驾驶行为方面仍有局限。本文针对高速公路变道场景，提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的个性化驾驶框架。该框架根据激进、正常、保守三种驾驶风格，将自然语言驾驶指令映射至开源Apollo自动驾驶栈中的可执行规划参数。为建立这一映射，首先基于生成的变道行为评估候选规划参数，并通过聚类与风格强度排序构建风格特定的参数集。在指令理解方面，构建检索数据集以支持检索增强生成（RAG），从而实现对隐含用户指令的LLM解析。实验结果表明，推导出的参数集可生成可区分的个性化变道行为，而RAG能持续提升偏好理解效果，尤其针对隐含指令。这些结果证明了将基于LLM的自然语言交互与Apollo系统集成以支持个性化变道行为生成的潜力。源代码及相关数据集见：https://github.com/ftgTUGraz/LLM-Personalized-Driving。

title: Stage-Transition Dense Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon robotic manipulation is often limited by sparse and delayed rewards, while manually designing dense shaping signals is costly and brittle to changes in environments and object configurations. This work proposes Stage-Transition Dense Reward (STDR), a visual reward-learning framework that converts unstructured expert videos into logically grounded dense rewards for training RL agents from scratch. STDR leverages semantic understanding to infer a task's stage structure from demonstrations, and delivers two complementary learning signals during online training: (i) stage-transition feedback that provides goal-directed reward, and (ii) within-stage progress feedback that supplies fine-grained guidance toward completing each stage. Furthermore, an out-of-distribution (OOD) detection mechanism and a grasping regulation module are integrated to enhance robustness and prevent reward hacking. Experiments on 14 manipulation tasks across MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and Franka Kitchen show that STDR consistently improves sample efficiency and success rates over multiple baselines, and matches or surpasses handcrafted dense rewards on several challenging tasks. Real-robot evaluations further indicate that STDR assigns stable, progress-aligned rewards on successful executions while producing appropriately low rewards for failures, suggesting robustness to visual noise and better-calibrated reward assignment across settings.
tldr: STDR converts unstructured expert videos into logically grounded dense rewards for long-horizon robotic manipulation RL, using stage-transition and within-stage progress feedback to improve sample efficiency and success rates.
tldr_zh: STDR将无结构的专家视频转化为逻辑驱动的密集奖励信号，用于长时域机器人操作强化学习，通过阶段转换和阶段内进度反馈提升样本效率和成功率。
summary_zh: 摘要：针对长时域机器人操作的强化学习通常受限于稀疏且延迟的奖励信号，而手动设计密集塑形信号不仅成本高昂，且对环境和物体配置的变化较为脆弱。本文提出阶段转换密集奖励（STDR），一种将非结构化专家视频转化为逻辑驱动的密集奖励的视觉奖励学习框架，用于从零开始训练强化学习智能体。STDR利用语义理解从示范中推断任务的阶段结构，并在在线训练过程中提供两种互补的学习信号：（i）阶段转换反馈，提供目标导向的奖励；（ii）阶段内进度反馈，为完成每个阶段提供细粒度的引导。此外，还集成了分布外（OOD）检测机制与抓取调节模块，以增强鲁棒性并防止奖励欺骗。在MetaWorld、ManiSkill和Franka Kitchen平台上的14项操作任务实验表明，STDR在多个基线上持续提升了样本效率与成功率，并在若干具有挑战性的任务上达到或超越了手工设计的密集奖励。真实机器人评估进一步显示，STDR在成功执行时能分配稳定且与进度一致的奖励，同时在失败时产生适当较低的奖励，表明其对视觉噪声具有鲁棒性，且在不同场景下具有更校准的奖励分配能力。

title: 3D HAMSTER: Bridging Planning and Control in Hierarchical Vision Language Action Models through 3D Trajectory Guidance
summary: Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models decouple high-level planning from low-level control to improve generalization in robot manipulation. Recent work in this paradigm uses 2D end-effector trajectories predicted by a Vision-Language Model (VLM) as explicit guidance for a downstream policy. However, state-of-the-art low-level policies operate in 3D metric space on point clouds, and feeding them 2D guidance that lacks depth forces each waypoint to be assigned the depth of whatever scene surface lies beneath it, producing geometrically distorted trajectories. We propose 3D HAMSTER, a hierarchical framework that closes this gap by having the planner directly output metrically reliable 3D trajectories. We augment a VLM with a dedicated depth encoder and a dense depth reconstruction objective to predict 3D waypoint sequences, which are directly integrated into a pointcloudbased low-level policy. Across 3D trajectory prediction, simulation, and real-world manipulation, 3D HAMSTER consistently outperforms proprietary VLMs and 2D-guided baselines, with the largest gains under appearance-altering shifts and unseen language, spatial, and visual conditions. The project page is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/3D_HAMSTER/.
tldr: This work proposes 3D HAMSTER, a hierarchical VLA framework that replaces 2D trajectory guidance with metrically reliable 3D trajectory prediction by augmenting a VLM with a depth encoder and dense depth reconstruction, improving robot manipulation under distribution shifts.
tldr_zh: 该工作提出3D HAMSTER，一种层级式VLA框架，通过为VLM增加深度编码器和密集深度重建目标，用度量可靠的3D轨迹预测替代2D轨迹引导，提升了机器人在分布偏移下的操作性能。
summary_zh: 分层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将高层规划与低层控制解耦，以提升机器人操作中的泛化能力。该范式下的近期研究采用由视觉-语言模型（VLM）预测的二维末端执行器轨迹，作为下游策略的显式引导。然而，当前最先进的低层控制策略在三维度量空间的点云上执行操作，向其输入缺乏深度信息的二维引导时，每个路径点被迫赋予其下方场景表面的深度值，从而产生几何畸变的轨迹。为此，我们提出3D HAMSTER——一种通过规划器直接输出度量可信三维轨迹以弥合上述差距的分层框架。通过为VLM配备专用深度编码器与密集深度重建目标函数，我们实现了三维路径点序列的预测，并将其直接集成至基于点云的低层控制策略中。在三维轨迹预测、仿真及真实世界操作实验中，3D HAMSTER始终优于专有VLM及二维引导基线方法，尤其在表观变换偏移、未见语言场景及空间视觉条件下优势最为显著。项目页面详见https://davian-robotics.github.io/3D_HAMSTER/。

title: Plan Right, Then Plan Tight: Symbolic RL for Efficient Embodied Reasoning
summary: Embodied task planning asks an agent to turn a natural-language instruction into an executable sequence of actions in a physical scene, and is a building block for household, assistive, and service robots. Recent prompting-based and reinforcement-learning planners generate fluent action text but lack a cheap deterministic check that the produced plan is valid in the target world, while high-fidelity simulation is too slow to serve as an inner-loop training signal. The general problem is therefore how to obtain verifiable supervision and rewards for embodied planners without relying on string-level matching or full simulation. Here we show that a single BDDL specification, automatically constructed from open-world video evidence or curated tasks, can serve as a shared interface for data construction, plan verification, and reward design. A video-to-BDDL parser, an LLM verifier, and a lightweight symbolic engine together supply dense feedback at millisecond latency. We further introduce GroupAdapt, a difficulty-aware length schedule that uses the in-batch group pass rate as a zero-cost signal so that hard prompts get wider length tolerance and automatically tighten as their pass rate improves. Under the guidance of the proposed verifier and GroupAdapt schedule, the 8B planner attains a Strict-Pass score of 97.3 on BEHAVIOR-1000, yielding a 25.9 percent relative improvement over the Qwen3-8B baseline. This result exceeds the strongest large-model baseline by 3.5 percent, while simultaneously compressing the response length by 79 percent to 207 tokens, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency.
tldr: This paper introduces a symbolic RL framework using BDDL specifications for verifiable supervision and reward in embodied task planning, achieving high pass rates and compressed response lengths on BEHAVIOR-1000.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种使用BDDL规范进行可验证监督和奖励的符号强化学习框架，在BEHAVIOR-1000上实现了高通过率和压缩响应长度。
summary_zh: 具身任务规划要求智能体将自然语言指令转化为物理场景中可执行的行动序列，这是家用、辅助及服务机器人的基础构建模块。当前基于提示学习和强化学习的规划器虽能生成流畅的动作文本，但缺乏低成本确定性验证手段来判断所生成计划在目标世界中的有效性，而高保真仿真因速度过慢无法作为内循环训练信号。因此，核心问题在于如何为具身规划器获取可验证的监督信号与奖励，同时避免依赖字符串匹配或完整仿真。本研究证明，单个BDDL规范（可从开放世界视频证据或精心设计的任务中自动构建）可作为数据构建、计划验证和奖励设计的共享接口。视频转BDDL解析器、大语言模型验证器和轻量级符号引擎协同运作，能在毫秒级延迟下提供密集反馈。我们进一步提出GroupAdapt——一种基于难度感知的长度调度策略，利用批次内组通过率作为零成本信号：困难提示可获得更宽的长度容差，并随通过率提升自动收紧容差。在提出的验证器与GroupAdapt调度策略指导下，8B参数规划器在BEHAVIOR-1000基准上达到97.3的严格通过率，较Qwen3-8B基线实现25.9%的相对提升。该结果超越最强的大模型基线3.5%，同时将响应长度压缩79%至207个token，展现出高效性与有效性。

title: TactX: Learning Shared Tactile Representations Across Diverse Sensors
summary: Tactile sensors provide critical information for contact-rich manipulation, yet tactile representations and policies remain tightly coupled to each specific sensor, limiting transferability across robots and hardware platforms. We propose TactX, a framework for learning a transferable tactile representation across sensors spanning three fundamentally different transduction modalities: resistive, magnetic, and vision-based. TactX maps heterogeneous tactile observations into a shared latent space through modality-specific encoders trained on paired contact data. Such paired interactions provide a natural alignment signal across modalities, and the encoders are jointly trained across all sensor pairs, inducing a consistent latent space for all sensor types. Our experiments show that TactX aligns tactile representations across sensors while preserving object-level contact information, as evidenced by sensor-identity prediction and object classification in the learned latent space. We evaluate TactX on four contact-rich manipulation tasks: pick-and-place, plug insertion, board wiping, and object reorientation, and show that policies trained with one sensor transfer zero-shot to physically distinct sensors through the shared latent. This improves the average success rate from 27.5% for vision-only policy to 45.9%, providing a step toward sensor-agnostic tactile manipulation.
tldr: TactX learns a shared tactile representation across sensors of different modalities (resistive, magnetic, vision-based) via paired contact data, enabling policy transfer from one sensor to another on real manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: TactX 通过配对接触数据学习跨不同模态（电阻、磁力、视觉）触觉传感器的共享表征，使在真实操作任务中从一个传感器到另一个传感器的策略迁移成为可能。
summary_zh: 触觉传感器为接触密集操作提供了关键信息，然而目前的触觉表征与控制策略仍与特定传感器紧密耦合，限制了跨机器人及硬件平台的可迁移性。我们提出TactX框架，用于学习一种可跨三种根本不同传感模态（电阻式、磁式和视觉式）迁移的触觉表征。TactX通过基于配对接触数据训练的模态专用编码器，将异构触觉观测映射至共享潜在空间。此类配对交互为跨模态对齐提供了天然信号，编码器在所有传感器对上联合训练，从而为所有传感器类型构建一致的潜在空间。实验表明，TactX在对齐跨传感器触觉表征的同时保留了物体级接触信息——学习所得潜在空间中的传感器身份预测与物体分类任务验证了这一点。我们评估了TactX在四种接触密集操作任务（拾放、插拔、板面擦拭与物体重定向）中的表现，结果显示：通过单一传感器训练的控制策略经共享潜在空间可直接零样本迁移至物理特性迥异的其他传感器。这使得仅依赖视觉的策略平均成功率从27.5%提升至45.9%，为迈向传感器无关的触觉操作奠定了关键一步。

title: Long-term Traffic Simulation via Structured Autoregressive Modeling
summary: Interactive traffic simulation is a vital world model for autonomous driving. A central challenge in long-horizon simulation is modeling sustained multi-agent interactions, which is further exacerbated by dynamic token cardinality as agents continuously enter and exit the scene. In this work, we propose that the solution lies in the synergy between the architectural inductive biases and statistical priors of large-scale sequence models, e.g., Large Language Models (LLMs). Our probing experiments reveal that the transferability of attention mechanisms and the distributional consistency between motion tokens and natural language enable small-scale, heavily frozen LLMs to rapidly adapt to traffic modeling. Building on this insight, we introduce RosettaSim, a unified framework that projects scene topology, agent states, and spawning intents into a structured autoregressive stream with variable length, achieving both strong short-term accuracy and stable long-horizon simulation fidelity. Furthermore, evaluating extended rollouts presents yet another hurdle, as one-to-one agent correspondence inevitably fades over time. To address this, we introduce Retrieval-based Traffic Evaluation (RTE), which retrieves semantically similar real-world scenarios as context-aware reference anchors. Experiments on the Waymo Open Sim Agent Challenge (WOSAC) demonstrate that RosettaSim achieves state-of-the-art performance in both short- and long-term simulation. Furthermore, RTE exhibits a stronger correlation with standard metrics ($r=0.83$) than existing approaches ($r=0.74$), indicating improved alignment with long-horizon simulation fidelity.
tldr: RosettaSim uses a structured autoregressive framework with a frozen LLM to model multi-agent traffic dynamics, achieving state-of-the-art long-horizon simulation fidelity for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: RosettaSim 利用结构化自回归框架与冻结的大语言模型，对多智能体交通动态进行建模，在自动驾驶的长时域模拟中取得了最先进的保真度。
summary_zh: 交互式交通仿真作为自动驾驶的核心世界模型，其长期仿真面临的核心挑战在于对持续多智能体交互的建模——而智能体不断进出场景导致的动态令牌基数变化，进一步加剧了这一难题。本研究表明，解决方案在于大规模序列模型（如大语言模型）的架构归纳偏置与统计先验之间的协同效应。我们通过探测实验发现，注意力机制的可迁移性以及运动令牌与自然语言之间的分布一致性，使得小规模、深度冻结的大语言模型能够快速适应交通建模任务。基于此发现，我们提出统一框架RosettaSim，该框架将场景拓扑、智能体状态与生成意图映射为可变长度的结构化自回归流，同时实现优异的短期精度与稳定的长期仿真保真度。此外，评估扩展推演面临着另一重挑战：智能体间的一一对应关系会随时间推移不可避免地弱化。为解决该问题，我们提出基于检索的交通评估方法（RTE），通过检索语义相似的真实场景作为上下文感知参考锚点。在Waymo开放仿真智能体挑战赛（WOSAC）上的实验表明，RosettaSim在短期与长期仿真中均达到最优性能。同时，RTE与标准指标的相关性（$r=0.83$）显著优于现有方法（$r=0.74$），显示出与长期仿真保真度更优的对齐效果。

title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
summary: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH augments a pretrained VLA backbone with three key innovations: (1) dual-scale temporal memory hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; (2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective carving out a semantic plan space to align multimodal context with action trajectories; and (3) a parallel action decoding scheme that replaces autoregressive generation with vector-wise prediction to maximize control throughput. Extensive evaluations on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and a real-world LeRobot platform demonstrate that MIRTH achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibiting emergent error recovery capabilities. The codes and collected datasets are released at http://github.com/kiva12138/mirth.
tldr: MIRTH introduces a unified VLA framework with dual-scale temporal memory hubs, mutual-information-driven latent reasoning tokens, and parallel action decoding to overcome temporal myopia, reasoning gaps, and inference inefficiency in robot control.
tldr_zh: MIRTH 提出了一种统一的 VLA 框架，包含双尺度时间记忆枢纽、互信息驱动的潜在推理令牌和并行动作解码，以克服机器人控制中的时间近视、推理间隙和推理效率低下问题。
summary_zh: VLA模型已成为将网络规模数据中的语义知识迁移至物理机器人控制的一种强大范式。然而，当前单帧架构存在固有局限性：忽视历史动态的时间短视、高层指令与底层电机指令之间的推理鸿沟，以及因自回归标量解码导致的推理效率低下。本文提出MIRTH这一统一框架以解决上述挑战。MIRTH通过三项关键创新对预训练VLA骨干模型进行增强：（1）双尺度时间记忆枢纽，将长期场景演化与短期运动趋势压缩为紧凑嵌入；（2）基于互信息目标优化的潜在推理令牌，刻画语义规划空间以对齐多模态上下文与动作轨迹；（3）并行动作解码方案，以向量级预测替代自回归生成，最大化控制吞吐量。在LIBERO仿真基准及真实世界LeRobot平台上的大量实验表明，MIRTH达到了最先进性能，并展现出涌现的错误恢复能力。相关代码与收集的数据集已发布于http://github.com/kiva12138/mirth。

title: ELASTIC: Efficiently Learning to Adaptively Scale Test-Time Compute for Generative Control Policies
summary: Generative control policies (GCPs), such as diffusion policies and flow-based vision-language-action models, enable test-time scaling in robot control. Test-time compute can be allocated along two axes: sequential scaling, which increases denoising steps to refine actions, and parallel scaling, which samples multiple candidate actions to search across modes of the policy distribution. However, the optimal allocation of sequential and parallel compute is hard to know a priori as it is state-, task-, and policy-dependent. For example, early stages of a grasp may benefit from broader parallel exploration, while near-contact phases may require more sequential refinement for precision. We present ELASTIC, an algorithm that learns state-dependent test-time compute schedules for GCPs. We formulate compute allocation as a meta-Markov Decision Process in which a meta-policy interacts with a frozen pretrained robot policy and selects sequential steps and parallel samples at each denoising iteration to maximize task success while minimizing compute. Using reinforcement learning, this meta-policy also learns adaptive compute schedules without access to the GCP's training data. Across simulated manipulation benchmarks with diffusion policies, ELASTIC Pareto-dominates fixed and single-axis scaling baselines at matched compute budgets. On real-world robot manipulation with the $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action model, ELASTIC matches best-of-$10$ success while reducing wall-clock latency by 34%.
tldr: ELASTIC learns a state-dependent test-time compute schedule for generative control policies (diffusion policies and VLA models) via a meta-RL approach, improving success rate while reducing compute or latency.
tldr_zh: ELASTIC 通过学习状态相关的测试时计算调度策略（针对扩散策略和 VLA 模型），在减少计算量或延迟的同时提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 生成式控制策略（GCP），例如扩散策略和基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型，能够在机器人控制中实现测试时扩展。测试时计算可沿两个维度分配：序贯扩展，即增加去噪步骤以细化动作；以及并行扩展，即采样多个候选动作以搜索策略分布的模态。然而，序贯计算与并行计算的最优分配难以先验确定，因其依赖于状态、任务和具体策略。例如，抓取早期阶段可能受益于更广泛的并行探索，而接近接触阶段则可能需要更多序贯细化以实现精度。我们提出ELASTIC算法，该算法能为GCP学习依赖于状态的测试时计算调度方案。我们将计算分配形式化为一个元马尔可夫决策过程，其中元策略与冻结的预训练机器人策略交互，并在每次去噪迭代中选择序贯步骤数和并行采样数，以最大化任务成功率同时最小化计算量。通过强化学习，该元策略无需访问GCP训练数据即可学习自适应计算调度。在基于扩散策略的模拟操作基准测试中，ELASTIC在相同计算预算下帕累托优于固定的单轴扩展基线。在使用π₀.₅视觉-语言-动作模型的真实机器人操作任务中，ELASTIC达到了与Best-of-10采样相当的成功率，同时将实际延迟降低了34%。

title: What Probing Reveals about Autonomous Driving: Linking Internal Prediction Errors to Ego Planning
summary: Large-scale datasets and fast simulators have enabled improvements in driving policies that appear safe and robust, yet strong performance in nominal scenarios can still mask flawed reasoning and unsafe heuristics. Summary scores from closed-loop simulators do not give significant insight into the policy, making it difficult to determine whether they truly predict the motion of surrounding vehicles, how the ego vehicle generates future plans, or whether they merely rely on brittle heuristics that happen to succeed in nominal scenarios. To better understand the limits and weaknesses of driving policies, we focus on probing for forms of prediction, i.e., where surrounding vehicles will move next, and planning, i.e., understanding how to generate safe trajectories. We focus on these two capabilities because they reflect behaviors expected of effective driving policies, and use their presence or absence to assess policy quality across data-driven behavior cloning and simulation-driven reinforcement learning policies. To evaluate the presence of these capabilities, we investigate them as a function of scale, asking whether the closed-loop gains from larger datasets and longer simulation training reflect stronger prediction and planning or merely better behavioral heuristics. We use linear probing and targeted perturbations in both imitation learning and reinforcement learning models to track when these internal signals emerge, plateau, or fail. Despite good closed-loop performance, policies often fail to form timely surrounding-vehicle predictions during near-collision events, revealing a limitation in the predictive signals available for ego planning. Finally, causal intervention shows that correcting mistaken predictions improves ego planning toward safer trajectories.
tldr: This paper uses probing and causal interventions to analyze whether driving policies learn genuine prediction and planning capabilities or rely on brittle heuristics, revealing that even strong closed-loop performance can mask faulty predictive signals.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过探针分析和因果干预研究驾驶策略是否真正学会了预测和规划能力，还是仅依赖脆弱的启发式方法，揭示了即使闭环表现良好也可能掩盖错误的预测信号。
summary_zh: 大规模数据集与快速仿真器推动了驾驶策略的改进，这些策略看似安全且鲁棒，但名义场景下的优异表现仍可能掩盖有缺陷的推理过程及不安全的启发式方法。闭环仿真器的综合评分无法为策略提供深入理解，导致难以判断其是否真正预测了周围车辆的运动、自车如何生成未来规划，抑或仅是依赖恰好在名义场景中成功的脆弱启发式方法。为深入理解驾驶策略的局限与缺陷，我们聚焦于两类能力的探测：预测能力（即周围车辆下一步将移动至何处）与规划能力（即理解如何生成安全轨迹）。选择这两项能力是因为它们反映了有效驾驶策略的预期行为，并通过其存在与否来评估数据驱动行为克隆与仿真驱动强化学习策略的质量。为评估这些能力的存在性，我们将其作为规模变量的函数进行研究，探究从更大数据集与更长仿真训练中获得的闭环增益究竟是更强大的预测与规划能力的体现，抑或仅是更好的行为启发式方法。我们采用线性探测与定向扰动技术，在模仿学习与强化学习模型中追踪这些内部信号的出现、饱和或失效过程。尽管策略展现出良好的闭环性能，但在近碰撞事件中往往无法及时形成周围车辆预测，揭示了自车规划可用的预测信号存在局限性。最后，因果干预实验表明，纠正错误预测能够改善自车规划，使其生成更安全的轨迹。

title: Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer of World-Action Models from Synthetic Priors
summary: Bridging the sim-to-real gap is a core challenge in deploying learned manipulation policies. Sim-to-real learning is attractive because it can replace expensive real robot demonstrations with scalable synthetic data, yet world-action models have not previously been shown to transfer from simulation to real robotic manipulation. We study whether a world-action model can be trained from synthetic priors and deployed zero-shot in the real world. To this end, we build upon Cosmos Policy, a video diffusion model adapted for visuomotor control. We construct simulation environments with extensive domain randomization and generate demonstrations using the AnyTask motion planning pipeline. We evaluate our approach across object lifting, drawer opening, and pick-and-place tasks using ${\sim}800$ synthetic demonstrations per task and no real demonstrations. When deployed zero-shot on a Franka Robot, our policy attains a 35\% average success rate. To our knowledge, this represents the first successful sim-to-real transfer of a world-action model for robotic manipulation.
tldr: This paper demonstrates the first successful zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of a world-action model for robotic manipulation, using synthetic training data only.
tldr_zh: 本文首次展示了世界动作模型在仅使用合成训练数据的情况下，成功实现从仿真到真实机器人操作的零样本迁移。
summary_zh: 弥合仿真到现实的差距是部署学习型操作策略的核心挑战。仿真到现实学习具有吸引力，因为它能用可扩展的合成数据替代昂贵的真实机器人演示，但此前从未有世界-动作模型被证明能从仿真迁移到真实机器人操作。我们研究能否从合成先验中训练世界-动作模型，并在真实世界中实现零样本部署。为此，我们基于Cosmos Policy——一种适用于视觉运动控制的视频扩散模型——进行构建。我们通过广泛的领域随机化构建仿真环境，并利用AnyTask运动规划流水线生成演示。我们在物体拾取、抽屉打开和抓取放置任务上评估方法，每个任务使用约800个合成演示且无真实演示。当在Franka机器人上零样本部署时，我们的策略达到35%的平均成功率。据我们所知，这代表了世界-动作模型在机器人操作中首次成功的仿真到现实迁移。

title: Warp RL: Reshaping Base Policy Distributions for Dynamics Adaptation
summary: Residual reinforcement learning adapts a pretrained robot policy by learning an additive correction to its actions. While effective when adaptation amounts to shifting the base policy's action distribution, additive corrections cannot change the distribution's shape, scale, or state-dependent geometry -- limitations we formalize as wrong variance, miscalibrated confidence, and non-uniform correction. We show that these matter under dynamics shift: when the base distribution is geometrically mismatched to the shifted system, residual correction can underperform even the unadapted policy. We propose Warp RL, a policy adaptation method that replaces additive residuals with an invertible, state-conditioned transformation of the base policy's action distribution. Instantiated with monotonic rational-quadratic spline flows (arXiv:1906.04032), Warp RL preserves identity initialization, strictly generalizes additive residual correction, and exposes a structured adaptation space suitable for both policy-gradient and gradient-free optimization. Across a variety of ManiSkill3 manipulation tasks with controlled dynamics shifts, Warp RL matches residual correction when translation is sufficient and substantially outperforms it when adaptation requires distributional reshaping. We further demonstrate that warping can replace additive correction in an off-policy sim-to-real pipeline, achieving comparable success rate with 30% faster task completion on a real-robot peg-insertion task.
tldr: Warp RL replaces additive residual correction in residual reinforcement learning with an invertible, state-conditioned normalizing flow to reshape the base policy's action distribution, enabling better adaptation under dynamics shift and outperforming standard residuals in both simulated and real-robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Warp RL 用可逆的、状态条件的归一化流替换残差强化学习中的加性残差校正，以重塑基础策略的动作分布，从而在动力学变化下实现更好的适应性，并在模拟和真实机器人操作任务中优于标准残差方法。
summary_zh: 残差强化学习通过在预训练策略的动作上学习一个加性修正项来对其进行适应。虽然当适应仅涉及平移基策略的动作分布时该方法有效，但加性修正无法改变分布的形态、尺度或状态依赖的几何结构——我们将这些局限性形式化为方差错误、置信度校准偏差及非均匀修正。我们证明，在动力学迁移条件下这些局限性会引发问题：当基分布与迁移后系统的几何结构不匹配时，残差修正的性能甚至可能不如未经适应的原始策略。为此，我们提出Warp RL——一种策略适应方法，它将加性残差替换为基于基策略动作分布的、以状态为条件的可逆变换。通过采用单调有理二次样条流（arXiv:1906.04032）实现，Warp RL保留了恒等初始化特性，严格泛化了加性残差修正，并提供了一个适用于策略梯度与无梯度优化的结构化适应空间。在多个具有受控动力学迁移的ManiSkill3操作任务中，当平移足以适应时Warp RL与残差修正性能相当，而在适应需要分布重塑时其性能显著优于后者。我们进一步证明，在离策略的仿真到现实迁移流程中，形变修正可替代加性修正：在真实机器人的插销插入任务中，该方法在保持相当成功率的同时，任务完成速度提升30%。

title: Labimus: A Simulation and Benchmark for Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation in Chemical Laboratory
summary: Laboratory automation has made remarkable progress through robotic platforms and AI-driven scientific reasoning. However, many laboratory operations (e.g., solid--solid transfer) remain inherently dynamic and require real-time adaptation to different materials and experimental conditions. Such precision-critical manipulations are difficult to standardize, motivating the use of humanoid robots with dexterous hands. Despite this opportunity, no existing benchmark evaluates humanoid manipulation in precision-critical laboratory environments. We present Labimus, to our knowledge, the first benchmark for humanoid dexterous manipulation in organic chemistry laboratories. Labimus reconstructs over 30 functionally faithful assets from real organic chemistry workstations through real-to-sim modeling, collectively covering the core operations of routine organic chemistry experiments. The benchmark integrates articulated laboratory instruments, particle-based powder physics, and closed-loop instrument readouts, enabling a complete manipulation-to-measurement pipeline. It further defines six atomic operations and a seven-step solid-weighing workflow derived from real laboratory standard operating procedures. We introduce a precision-aware evaluation protocol designed to jointly measure task completion, experimental precision, and long-horizon execution. We benchmark three representative policies under procedural layouts and environmental perturbations. Results reveal a precision gap: policies that successfully complete laboratory tasks can still fail to satisfy the quantitative tolerances required by experimental protocols. Our benchmark exposes a fundamental disconnect between task completion and experimental validity, providing a new testbed for developing reliable humanoid robots for scientific laboratories.
tldr: Labimus is the first benchmark for humanoid dexterous manipulation in organic chemistry laboratories, featuring real-to-sim assets, particle physics, and a precision-aware evaluation protocol that reveals a gap between task completion and experimental validity.
tldr_zh: Labimus是首个针对有机化学实验室中仿人灵巧操作的基准测试，包含真实到仿真建模、粒子物理和精度感知评估协议，揭示了任务完成与实验有效性之间的差距。
summary_zh: 实验室自动化通过机器人平台和人工智能驱动的科学推理取得了显著进展。然而，许多实验室操作（如固体-固体转移）本质上仍是动态的，需要实时适应不同的材料和实验条件。这类对精度要求极高的操作难以标准化，从而推动了配备灵巧手的仿人机器人的应用。尽管存在这一机遇，但目前尚无现有基准能够评估仿人机器人在精度关键型实验室环境中的操作能力。我们提出了Labimus——据我们所知，这是首个针对有机化学实验室中仿人灵巧操作的基准。通过真实到仿真建模，Labimus从真实有机化学工作站重建了30多个功能保真的资产，共同覆盖了常规有机化学实验的核心操作。该基准集成了关节式实验室仪器、基于粒子的粉末物理模型以及闭环仪器读数，构建了从操作到测量的完整流程。它还基于真实实验室标准操作程序定义了六种原子操作和一个七步固体称量工作流程。我们引入了一种精度感知式评估协议，旨在联合衡量任务完成度、实验精度和长时域执行能力。我们在程序化布局和环境扰动下对三种代表性策略进行了基准测试。结果揭示了一个精度差距：能够成功完成实验室任务的策略仍可能无法满足实验规程所要求的定量容差。我们的基准暴露了任务完成与实验有效性之间的根本性脱节，为开发适用于科学实验室的可靠仿人机器人提供了新的测试平台。

title: Multisensory Continual Learning: Adapting Pretrained Visuomotor Policies to Force
summary: Robot manipulation often relies on sensory feedback beyond vision, particularly in contact-rich settings where force, tactile, or audio signals reveal interaction states that are not directly observable from images. However, these modalities are often hardware- and task-specific, and large-scale multisensory robot datasets remain scarce. As a result, it is impractical to pretrain policies with every sensor they may encounter. We study multisensory continual learning: adapting a pretrained robot policy to new tasks with newly introduced modalities while preserving performance under the original sensor suite. We propose MuSe, which incorporates limited multisensory data into pretrained vision-only policies through multi-stage fusion, multisensory future prediction, and experience replay over pretraining data. We instantiate MuSe by augmenting a pretrained vision-only policy with force-torque sensing and evaluate it on real-world manipulation tasks. Our experiments show that MuSe performs strongly on contact-rich finetuning tasks while preserving, and in some cases improving, performance on the original pretraining tasks. These results suggest that a modest multisensory dataset can improve general robot capabilities beyond the finetuning distribution. Project website: https://jadenvc.github.io/multisensory-continual-learning/
tldr: This paper introduces multisensory continual learning, adapting a pretrained vision-only robot policy to new tasks with additional force-torque sensing while preserving original task performance, using multi-stage fusion, multisensory future prediction, and experience replay.
tldr_zh: 本文提出多感官持续学习方法，将预训练的纯视觉机器人策略适应到带有力觉传感的新任务，同时保持原始任务性能，采用多阶段融合、多感官未来预测和经验回放。
summary_zh: 机器人操控通常依赖于视觉之外的感官反馈，尤其是在接触密集环境中，力觉、触觉或音频信号能够揭示图像无法直接观测的交互状态。然而，这些模态通常依赖于特定硬件和任务，且大规模多感官机器人数据集仍然稀缺。因此，针对每种可能遇到的传感器预训练策略并不现实。本文研究多感官持续学习：使预训练的机器人策略适应引入新模态的新任务，同时保持原始传感器套件下的性能。我们提出MuSe方法，通过多阶段融合、多感官未来预测以及基于预训练数据的经验回放，将有限的多感官数据整合到预训练的纯视觉策略中。我们通过为预训练的纯视觉策略增加力-力矩感知来实例化MuSe，并在真实世界的操控任务中对其进行评估。实验表明，MuSe在接触密集的微调任务上表现优异，同时保持甚至在某些情况下提升了原始预训练任务的性能。这些结果表明，适度的多感官数据集能够超越微调分布，提升机器人的通用能力。项目网站：https://jadenvc.github.io/multisensory-continual-learning/

title: Motion Planning in Compressed Representation Spaces
summary: Deep learning methods have vastly expanded the capabilities of motion planning in robotics applications, as learning priors from large-scale data has been shown to be essential in capturing the highly complex behavior required for solving tasks such as manipulation or navigation for autonomous vehicles. At the same time, model-based planning algorithms based on search or optimization remain an essential tool due to their flexibility, efficiency, and the ability to incorporate domain knowledge via expert-designed algorithms and objective functions. We propose a new generative framework to unify these two paradigms. First, we learn an autoencoder with a high compression ratio and a latent space of hierarchically ordered, discrete-valued tokens. Leveraging both the dimensionality reduction and the hierarchical coarse-to-fine structure learned by this autoencoder, we then perform motion planning by directly searching in the latent space of tokens. This search can optimize arbitrary objective functions specified at test time, providing a large degree of flexibility while maintaining efficiency and producing realistic solutions by relying on the generative capabilities of the highly compressed autoencoder. We evaluate our method on nuPlan and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, showing how latent space search can be used for a variety of guided behavior generation tasks, achieving strong performance for closed-loop motion planning and multi-agent guided scenario synthesis without requiring any task-specific training.
tldr: This paper proposes a generative framework that trains a high-compression autoencoder with hierarchical discrete tokens, then performs motion planning via search in the latent space, enabling flexible optimization for closed-loop driving and scenario synthesis without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种生成式框架，通过学习高压缩比的分层离散自编码器，在潜在空间中直接搜索进行运动规划，从而无需特定任务训练即可实现灵活的闭环驾驶和多智能体场景生成。
summary_zh: 深度学习方法极大地扩展了机器人应用中运动规划的能力，因为从大规模数据中学习先验知识已被证明对于捕捉解决诸如自主车辆的操纵或导航等任务所需的高度复杂行为至关重要。与此同时，基于搜索或优化的模型驱动规划算法因其灵活性、高效性以及能够通过专家设计的算法和目标函数融入领域知识，仍是不可或缺的工具。我们提出了一种新的生成框架来统一这两种范式。首先，我们学习一个具有高压缩比以及层级有序离散值标记潜空间的自动编码器。利用该自动编码器实现的降维和层级化由粗到精的结构，我们直接对标记的潜空间进行搜索来执行运动规划。这种搜索能够优化在测试阶段指定的任意目标函数，在提供高度灵活性的同时保持效率，并依靠高压缩自动编码器的生成能力产生逼真的解决方案。我们在nuPlan和Waymo开放运动数据集上评估了我们的方法，展示了潜空间搜索如何用于多种引导行为生成任务，在闭环运动规划和多智能体引导场景合成中实现了强劲性能，且无需任何任务特定的训练。

title: Off the Rails: Hijacking the Scoring Head in Generative End-to-End Driving Planners with Safety-Violating Adversarial Perturbations
summary: Generative models have recently seen rapid adoption in End-to-End (E2E) autonomous driving (AD), with diffusion-based denoising and vocabulary-based retrieval becoming the dominant trajectory-decoding paradigms.
