Despite their architectural diversity, current generative AD planners share a common inference pattern: a fixed set of candidate trajectories (anchors, vocabulary entries, or proposal queries) is scored by one or more learned heads conditioned on the Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features, and the highest-scored candidate is returned as the final trajectory. Under this design, the scoring head is the only barrier between perception and the motion command, and its decision margins between competing candidates are often small. We introduce \textsc{Derail}, an adversarial framework that exploits this scoring-head attack surface. Evaluated on various generative planners, \textsc{Derail} flips the trajectory selection from a safe to an unsafe candidate, with score drops of $39$--$80\%$ and collision rates of up to $50\%$, consistently outperforming generic loss-maximization and feature-divergence attacks. Our analysis suggests that safety-violating objectives govern attack effectiveness against generative AD planners, and that the scoring-head inference pattern itself is a recurring attack surface worth explicit defensive consideration.
tldr: This paper identifies a common scoring-head attack surface in generative end-to-end driving planners and proposes Derail, an adversarial framework that swaps safe trajectory candidates for unsafe ones, achieving high collision rates and significant score drops across multiple planners.
tldr_zh: 本文发现了生成式端到端驾驶规划器中普遍存在的评分头攻击面，并提出了 Derail 对抗框架，将安全轨迹候选替换为不安全候选，在多个规划器上实现了高碰撞率和显著的分数下降。
summary_zh: 生成式模型近期在端到端自动驾驶领域得到快速采纳，基于扩散的去噪方法和基于词汇的检索成为主流的轨迹解码范式。尽管架构多样，当前生成式自动驾驶规划器共享相同的推理模式：一个固定候选轨迹集（锚点、词汇条目或提议查询）通过一个或多个基于鸟瞰图特征训练的分类头进行评分，得分最高的候选轨迹被输出为最终轨迹。在此设计下，分类头成为感知系统与运动指令之间的唯一屏障，且其决策边界在竞争候选轨迹间往往较小。我们提出对抗性框架\textsc{Derail}，专门利用这一分类头攻击面。在多种生成式规划器上的评估显示，\textsc{Derail}能将轨迹选择从安全候选翻转为不安全候选，评分下降39\%--80\%，碰撞率高达50\%，持续优于通用损失最大化攻击和特征发散攻击。我们的分析表明，违反安全的目标决定了针对生成式自动驾驶规划器的攻击效果，而分类头推理模式本身就是一个值得主动防御考虑的反复出现的攻击面。

title: From Grasps to Dexterity: Large-Scale Grasp Pretraining for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Large-scale dexterous grasp datasets encode rich priors over hand-object interaction, but their use has largely been confined to grasp generation and pick-and-place manipulation. We study whether such data can instead support functional dexterity in articulated tool use, where a robot must acquire a tool, maintain contact, and operate its functional moving parts. We adapt a hierarchical imitation learning framework that combines high-level hand sub-goal prediction with a low-level goal-conditioned controller. We construct a 355k-trajectory grasp-pretraining dataset from large-scale dexterous grasp annotations and use it to pretrain the low-level controller. The controller is then fine-tuned on downstream task demonstrations. To evaluate this setting, we introduce DexCraft, a simulation benchmark with six articulated tool-use tasks requiring coordinated finger motion. Across simulation and real-world experiments, our approach outperforms end-to-end diffusion policy baselines and hierarchical policies trained from scratch. In the real world, it improves full-task success by 33.3 percentage points over DP3. These results show that grasp datasets can serve not only as resources for grasp synthesis, but also as scalable pretraining data for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. Videos are shown on https://yingyuan0414.github.io/grasp2dexterity/ .
tldr: This paper shows that large-scale dexterous grasp datasets can be used to pretrain low-level controllers for functional articulated tool use, outperforming baselines on a new simulation benchmark and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文证明大规模灵巧抓取数据集可用于预训练低级控制器，实现功能性铰接工具操作，在仿真和真实世界中均优于基线方法。
summary_zh: 大规模灵巧抓取数据集编码了丰富的手-物交互先验知识，但其应用长期以来主要局限于抓取生成与拾取放置操作。本文探究此类数据是否可支撑关节工具的灵巧功能操作——机器人需获取工具、保持接触并操控其功能性活动部件。我们采用分层模仿学习框架，将高层手部子目标预测与低层目标条件控制器相结合。基于大规模灵巧抓取注释构建了包含35.5万条轨迹的抓取预训练数据集，用于低层控制器的预训练，随后在下游任务演示数据上进行微调。为评估该设定，我们提出DexCraft仿真基准，包含六项需要协调手指运动的关节工具使用任务。在仿真与真实世界实验中，我们的方法优于端到端扩散策略基线及从零训练的分层策略。在真实场景中，相较于DP3方法，完整任务成功率提升33.3个百分点。这些结果表明，抓取数据集不仅可作为抓取合成的资源，更能作为接触密集型灵巧操作的可扩展预训练数据。视频演示见https://yingyuan0414.github.io/grasp2dexterity/。

title: DriveWeaver: Point-Conditioned Video Inpainting for Controllable Vehicle Insertion in Autonomous Driving Simulation
summary: A pivotal step in autonomous driving simulation involves inserting foreground vehicles with predefined trajectories into simulated scenes. This process enhances scene diversity and facilitates the creation of various corner cases for testing and improving autonomous driving models. However, existing methods often rely on pre-reconstructed 3D assets, which frequently lead to lighting inconsistencies between the inserted foreground and the background. Moreover, the reliance on limited, manually-curated 3D assets hinders large-scale deployment. To address these challenges, we propose DriveWeaver, a novel framework for controllable vehicle insertion in autonomous driving simulation. Specifically, for a masked target insertion area, DriveWeaver performs video inpainting conditioned on vehicle point clouds to generate high-quality, temporally consistent vehicles. This video-inpainting-based approach ensures seamless blending between the foreground and background, while the readily available point cloud conditions enable superior generalization. To support long-term generation, we further design a global-to-local hierarchical inpainting strategy, ensuring the consistent identity and appearance of the inserted vehicles. Meanwhile, we extract explicit 3D Gaussian representations of the inserted vehicles through an urban reconstruction pipeline to enable real-time rendering for autonomous driving simulation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines in visual realism and geometric consistency, providing a robust tool for scalable autonomous driving scene augmentation.
tldr: DriveWeaver is a video inpainting framework that inserts foreground vehicles into autonomous driving simulation scenes using point cloud conditions, achieving realistic blending and scalable scene augmentation.
tldr_zh: DriveWeaver 是一种视频修复框架，通过点云条件将前景车辆插入自动驾驶模拟场景，实现逼真的融合和可扩展的场景增强。
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶仿真的关键步骤中，需要将具有预设轨迹的前景车辆插入模拟场景。这一过程增强了场景多样性，有助于创建各类边缘案例，用于测试和改进自动驾驶模型。然而，现有方法通常依赖预重建的三维资产，这常导致插入的前景与背景之间存在光照不一致问题。此外，对有限的、人工筛选的三维资产的依赖阻碍了大规模部署。为应对这些挑战，我们提出DriveWeaver——一种用于自动驾驶仿真中可控车辆插入的新颖框架。具体而言，对于掩码标记的目标插入区域，DriveWeaver以车辆点云为条件进行视频修复，生成高质量、时间一致的车辆。这种基于视频修复的方法确保了前景与背景的无缝融合，而易于获取的点云条件则实现了卓越的泛化能力。为支持长时生成，我们进一步设计了从全局到局部的层级修复策略，确保所插入车辆的身份和外观保持一致性。同时，我们通过城市重建流程提取插入车辆的显式三维高斯表征，以实现自动驾驶仿真的实时渲染。在多种数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在视觉真实感和几何一致性上优于现有基线，为可扩展的自动驾驶场景增强提供了稳健工具。

title: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with Dual Range-Voxel Representation
summary: LiDAR-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction, which aims to provide accurate and comprehensive scene representation, is crucial for autonomous driving systems. As point clouds suffer from sparsity and incompleteness, leading to insufficient semantic learning and difficult occupancy perception, existing methods often stack multi-sweep point clouds to obtain dense spatial information. However, such a naive strategy also results in efficiency (e.g., additional computational burden) and robustness (e.g., pose transformation noise) concerns, which hinder their practical applications. In this work, we propose a Dual Range-Voxel Representation (DRVR) that leverages the range-view context and voxel-view geometry of single-sweep point clouds for 3D semantic occupancy prediction, eliminating the concerns associated with the multi-sweeps. Specifically, we use the range-view encoder to extract the compact context of the scene. To fully exploit the spatial information, we design a geometry-aware voxel-view encoder that extracts multi-scale voxel-view features separately and combines them for better geometric occupancy prediction. Moreover, we propose a range-voxel fusion module to cooperate range- and voxel-view features via voxel-to-range and range-to-voxel fusions. Extensive experiments on nuScenes-Occupancy, SemanticKITTI and SemanticPOSS show the superiority of our method. Especially on nuScenes-Occupancy, our single-sweep DRVR achieves 5.4% improvement in mIoU and 2.1x acceleration compared to the multi-sweep method.
tldr: A single-sweep LiDAR semantic occupancy prediction method using dual range-voxel representation to improve accuracy and efficiency for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 一种利用双范围-体素表示的单扫描LiDAR语义占用预测方法，在自动驾驶中提高了精度和效率。
summary_zh: 基于激光雷达的3D语义占据预测旨在提供准确且全面的场景表征，对自动驾驶系统至关重要。由于点云存在稀疏性与不完整性，导致语义学习不足和占据感知困难，现有方法通常通过堆叠多帧点云来获取密集空间信息。然而，这种简单策略也引发了效率（如额外计算负担）和鲁棒性（如位姿变换噪声）问题，限制了其实际应用。本文提出一种双范围-体素表征方法（DRVR），利用单帧点云的范围视图上下文和体素视图几何信息实现3D语义占据预测，从而规避多帧策略的上述问题。具体而言，我们使用范围视图编码器提取场景的紧凑上下文。为充分利用空间信息，我们设计了几何感知体素视图编码器，分别提取多尺度体素视图特征并将其融合以实现更优的几何占据预测。此外，我们提出范围-体素融合模块，通过体素到范围和范围到体素的双向融合协作范围视图与体素视图特征。在nuScenes-Occupancy、SemanticKITTI和SemanticPOSS上的大量实验证明了本方法的优越性。尤其在nuScenes-Occupancy上，与多帧方法相比，我们的单帧DRVR在mIoU上提升了5.4%，同时实现了2.1倍加速。

title: WorldRoamBench: An Open-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Stability of Interactive World Models
summary: Despite rapid progress in interactive world models (IWMs), existing benchmarks evaluate action following only at trajectory level and ignore memory and interaction physics. We introduce WorldRoamBench, an open-world benchmark for long-horizon stability across four dimensions, each with tailored innovations: (i) Action: per-frame action metric bypassing cross-model semantic scale disparity and exposing failures hidden by trajectory; (ii) Vision: segment-based drift metric capturing non-monotonic mid-sequence collapse missed by start-vs-end comparisons; (iii) Physics: controllability-gated evaluation over mechanics, optics, and 3D consistency, scoring plausibility under faithful action execution; (iv) Memory: action-decoupled protocol evaluating scene memory via transition-localized 3D point-cloud reconstruction and subject memory via tracking-plus-VLM reasoning. The benchmark comprises 600+ test cases across Nature, Urban, and Indoor scenes in first/third-person views with WASD 10-60s continuous interaction. Evaluating 10+ open/closed-source models reveals none reliably satisfies all dimensions; even the best achieves only moderate scores. Advances on WorldRoamBench are steps toward IWMs that are stable, physically grounded, memory-faithful, and deployable in real-world applications.
tldr: WorldRoamBench is a new benchmark that evaluates interactive world models across four dimensions (action, vision, physics, memory) with 600+ test cases, revealing that current models fail to achieve stable, physically grounded, and memory-faithful performance.
tldr_zh: WorldRoamBench 是一个针对交互式世界模型的新基准，从动作、视觉、物理和记忆四个维度进行评测（包含 600 多个测试用例），揭示了现有模型在稳定性、物理真实性和记忆保真度方面的不足。
summary_zh: 尽管交互式世界模型（IWMs）已取得快速进展，但现有基准测试仅在轨迹级别评估动作跟随能力，且忽略了记忆和交互物理特性。我们提出WorldRoamBench，这是一个面向四维长时稳定性的开放世界基准测试，每个维度均具有针对性创新：（i）动作：逐帧动作度量，可规避跨模型语义尺度差异，并暴露被轨迹掩盖的失败案例；（ii）视觉：基于分段的漂移度量，可捕捉首尾对比无法发现的非单调中间序列崩溃；（iii）物理：可控制性门控评估，涵盖力学、光学与三维一致性，在忠实动作执行下对合理性进行评分；（iv）记忆：动作解耦协议，通过过渡局部化三维点云重建评估场景记忆，并通过追踪加视觉-语言模型推理评估主体记忆。该基准测试包含自然场景、城市场景与室内场景中第一/第三人称视角的600余个测试案例，并支持WASD连续交互10至60秒。对10余个开源/闭源模型的评估显示，没有任何模型能可靠满足所有维度要求；即使表现最佳的模型也仅获得中等分数。在WorldRoamBench上的进步，将是迈向稳定、具备物理基础、忠实于记忆且可在现实应用中部署的交互式世界模型的关键步骤。

title: DrivingDepth: Sparse-Prompted Pixel-wise Scale Correction for Driving Depth Estimation
summary: Dense depth estimation for autonomous driving faces a geometry-scale conflict: depth foundation models deliver pixel-aligned dense visual geometry without reliable metric scale, while projected LiDAR provides metric anchors that are sparse, noisy, and misaligned with image structures. Existing sparse-prompted methods incorporate LiDAR by regenerating depth from scratch, overriding the foundation model's coherent geometry and producing structural artifacts on visually continuous surfaces. Our key insight is that foundation models already capture geometrically coherent relative depth; no additional surface structure learning is required-only a per-pixel scale factor mapping relative geometry to metric coordinates. Based on this, we propose DrivingDepth, which treats sparse LiDAR as geometric prompts that locally calibrate a frozen foundation prior through residual pixel-wise scale correction, preserving dense visual geometry by construction. On nuScenes with 4-frame surround-view input, DrivingDepth achieves an AbsRel of 11.19 and an EdgeCR of 5.741, outperforming MapAnything (11.99/1.914) by simultaneously delivering SOTA metric accuracy and geometric consistency.
tldr: DrivingDepth proposes a sparse-prompted pixel-wise scale correction method that uses LiDAR points to locally calibrate a frozen depth foundation model, achieving state-of-the-art metric accuracy and geometric consistency for autonomous driving depth estimation.
tldr_zh: DrivingDepth 提出了一种稀疏提示的逐像素尺度校正方法，利用激光雷达点局部校准冻结的深度基础模型，在自动驾驶深度估计中实现了最先进的度量精度和几何一致性。
summary_zh: 面向自动驾驶的稠密深度估计面临几何-尺度冲突：深度基础模型能够输出像素对齐的稠密视觉几何信息，但缺乏可靠的度量尺度；而激光雷达投影数据虽然提供了度量锚点，却存在稀疏、噪声大且与图像结构错位的问题。现有稀疏提示方法通过从头重建深度来融合激光雷达数据，这种做法覆盖了基础模型原有的连贯几何结构，在视觉连续表面上产生结构伪影。我们的关键洞察在于：基础模型已能捕获几何连贯的相对深度，无需额外学习表面结构——仅需一个逐像素的尺度因子将相对几何映射到度量坐标。基于此，我们提出DrivingDepth方法，将稀疏激光雷达作为几何提示，通过残差式像素级尺度校正对冻结的基础模型先验进行局部校准，从而在结构上保持稠密视觉几何。基于nuScenes数据集四帧环视输入，DrivingDepth的AbsRel达到11.19，EdgeCR为5.741，在同时实现SOTA度量精度与几何一致性方面优于MapAnything（11.99/1.914）。

title: ForgeDrive: Bidirectional Cross-Conditioning for Unified Visual-Action Generation in Autonomous Driving
summary: World-model-based autonomous driving endows the model with the ability to understand scene evolution. Yet this promise is undermined by the prevailing imagine-then-act paradigm, which allows errors from the more challenging visual generation stage to cascade into action planning. We introduce ForgeDrive, a unified autoregressive diffusion framework with visual-action cross-conditioning that closes this gap through act-then-imagine paradigm. ForgeDrive factorizes the future as a sequence of per-timestep frame-action pairs, intertwining each action with its corresponding visual observation. During training, we decouple the diffusion timesteps of the two modalities and introduce a UniDiffuser-style noise scheduler to get the ability to infer either modality from its counterpart and deepen understanding of relationships between images and actions. At inference, we propose a novel act-then-imagine inference paradigm, and find that at each step, action generation is a capability internalized during training, requiring no clean future frame as a prerequisite at inference time; instead, the generated action can improve the accuracy of future frame generation, which in turn enhances the quality of the next action. Additionally, we augment each step with future ego-status prediction, further sharpening planning ability. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate that ForgeDrive not only unifies driving simulation, planning, and visual odometry into a single model, but also outperforms existing strong planners without any post-training strategy.
tldr: ForgeDrive unifies visual generation and action planning in autonomous driving via a bidirectional cross-conditioning autoregressive diffusion framework, enabling an 'act-then-imagine' paradigm that outperforms existing planners on NAVSIM.
tldr_zh: ForgeDrive 通过双向交叉条件自回归扩散框架统一了自动驾驶中的视觉生成与动作规划，实现了“先行动后想象”范式，在 NAVSIM 上优于现有规划器。
summary_zh: 基于世界模型的自动驾驶赋予模型理解场景演化的能力。然而，当前主流的"先想象后行动"范式削弱了这一前景——该范式使得更具挑战性的视觉生成阶段产生的错误会级联传导至动作规划环节。我们提出ForgeDrive，一个采用视觉-动作交叉条件约束的统一自回归扩散框架，通过"先行动后想象"范式弥合这一鸿沟。ForgeDrive将未来状态分解为逐时间步的帧-动作对序列，使每个动作与其对应的视觉观测相互交织。在训练阶段，我们解耦两种模态的扩散时间步，引入类UniDiffuser噪声调度器，从而获得从任一模态推断另一模态的能力，并深化对图像与动作之间关联的理解。在推理阶段，我们提出新颖的"先行动后想象"推理范式，发现每个时间步的动作生成是训练过程中内化的能力，无需以清洁的未来帧作为推理前提；相反，生成的动作可提升未来帧生成的准确性，进而增强后续动作的质量。此外，我们通过在每个时间步增加未来自我状态预测来进一步强化规划能力。在NAVSIM上的大量实验表明，ForgeDrive不仅将驾驶模拟、规划与视觉里程计统一至单一模型，且无需任何后训练策略即能超越现有强规划器。

title: Reasoning-aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) planners for autonomous driving emit a chain-of-causation (CoC) reasoning step \emph{before} producing a trajectory. The reasoning is autoregressive and dominates inference latency, while the trajectory head is parallel and cheap. Latency is an operational constraint in autonomous driving, so accelerating the reasoning step is the central problem we address. We observe that CoC reasoning has two qualitatively different needs: most tokens continue routine setup that follows naturally from the ego-trajectory history, and a small fraction encode commitments that require fresh visual evidence about an unexpected situation. We split this reasoning into two specialized paths: a \emph{routine reasoner} that handles the predictable continuation by attending to trajectory history, and a \emph{deliberative reasoner} (the unmodified VLA target) that handles novel cases by attending to current visual evidence, using the speculative decoding framework as the architectural template for how the two paths cooperate. Unlike standard speculative decoding, our routine reasoner is not a smaller replica of the target; the two reasoners are deliberately specialized to read different parts of the prompt. We propose two techniques to realize this. First, we introduce \textbf{FlatRoPE}, a 1D rotary positional embedding in the draft that breaks the rotational symmetry of the target's 3D M-RoPE, redirecting attention away from visual tokens and onto trajectory-history tokens. Second, we introduce \textbf{Action-aware RL (AARL)}, a post-training stage that uses an action-quality reward together with a static-reference KL anchor. Together, our two-reasoner system reduces the reasoning-step running time by approximately $4\times$ relative to the original Alpamayo planner.
tldr: This paper proposes a two-path speculative decoding system (routine+deliberative reasoner) with FlatRoPE and Action-aware RL to accelerate the autoregressive reasoning step of a VLA planner for autonomous driving, achieving ~4x speedup.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种双路径推测解码系统（常规推理器+审慎推理器），结合FlatRoPE和行动感知强化学习，加速自动驾驶VLA规划器的自回归推理步骤，实现了约4倍加速。
summary_zh: 现代自动驾驶中的视觉-语言-行为（VLA）规划器在生成轨迹*之前*会输出一个因果链（CoC）推理步骤。该推理过程是自回归的，主导了推理延迟，而轨迹头则是并行且计算成本较低的。延迟是自动驾驶中的运行约束，因此加速推理步骤是我们解决的核心问题。我们观察到，CoC推理存在两种性质不同的需求：大部分token延续基于自车轨迹历史自然形成的常规设置，而少量token则编码了需要针对突发情况获取新视觉证据的决策意图。我们将这一推理过程拆分为两条专用路径：一个*常规推理器*，通过关注轨迹历史来处理可预测的延续部分；以及一个*深思推理器*（未经修改的VLA目标模型），通过关注当前视觉证据来处理新出现的情况，并采用推测解码框架作为两条路径协作的架构模板。与标准推测解码不同，我们的常规推理器并非目标模型的缩小版副本；两个推理器特意针对提示语的不同部分进行专业化处理。我们提出两种技术来实现这一点。首先，我们引入**FlatRoPE**，一种在草稿模型中使用的一维旋转位置编码，旨在打破目标模型三维M-RoPE的旋转对称性，将注意力从视觉token重新导向轨迹历史token。其次，我们引入**动作感知强化学习（AARL）**，一个后训练阶段，它使用动作质量奖励和静态参考KL散度锚点。综合而言，我们的双推理器系统相比原始Alpamayo规划器，将推理步骤的运行时间减少了约$4\times$。

title: InfiniVerse: Occupancy Guided Unbounded Scene Generation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Generating realistic, controllable, and temporally coherent urban environments is a critical yet unresolved challenge in the autonomous driving community. In this paper, we introduce InfiniVerse, a unified pipeline for long-range, 2D-3D-aligned, and controllable synthesis of dynamic urban scenes from a single frame. In practice, our approach first reconstructs a 3D occupancy representation from the input multi-view frame. This representation serves as a foundation for autoregressive scene extension along arbitrary trajectories. Subsequently, a video diffusion model translates the coarse occupancy grid into realistic, spatiotemporally consistent video sequences. Moreover, we propose a hierarchical sketch-and-refine paradigm, in which the generated videos are re-projected as image-conditioned feedback to enhance the 3D occupancy representation, establishing cross-modal alignment and mutual enhancement between the visual and spatial domains. Extensive evaluations on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes demonstrate that InfiniVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a FID of 6.4 and FVD of 67.97, significantly outperforming existing benchmarks in both duration and stability.
tldr: InfiniVerse is a unified pipeline for generating long-range, controllable, and temporally coherent dynamic urban driving scenes from a single multi-view frame, using 3D occupancy reconstruction and video diffusion with a hierarchical sketch-and-refine mechanism.
tldr_zh: InfiniVerse是一个从单个多视角帧生成可控、长距离且时间一致的动态城市场景的统一流程，它结合了3D占用率重建与视频扩散，并采用层次化的草图-精炼机制。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在自动驾驶领域，生成逼真、可控且时序一致的城市场景是一项关键但尚未解决的挑战。本文提出InfiniVerse——一种从单帧图像出发，实现远程、2D-3D对齐且可控的动态城市场景合成的统一流程。具体而言，该方法首先从输入的多视角帧中重建三维占据表示，该表示作为沿任意轨迹进行自回归场景扩展的基础；随后，视频扩散模型将粗糙的占据网格转化为真实且时空一致的视频序列。此外，我们提出一种分层式的“草图-细化”范式，其中生成的视频被重新投影为图像条件反馈以增强三维占据表示，从而建立视觉域与空间域之间的跨模态对齐与相互强化。在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上的大量评估表明，InfiniVe rs e实现了最先进的性能，其FID为6.4，FVD为67.97，在时长与稳定性方面均显著优于现有基准。

title: MVP-Nav: Multi-layer Value Map Planner Navigator
summary: Zero-shot Object Goal Navigation (ZSON) with RGB-only perception poses a fundamental challenge for embodied agents, as the absence of explicit depth information introduces severe physical uncertainty and semantic-physical misalignment. Existing approaches either rely on high-level semantic reasoning without geometric grounding or learn end-to-end policies that lack explicit physical constraints, often resulting in semantically plausible but physically unsafe behaviors. In this paper, we propose MVP-Nav, a physical-aware RGB-only navigation framework that aligns perception, planning, and control with the real 3D world. MVP-Nav reconstructs explicit physical occupancy from monocular observations by leveraging 3D foundation models to project 2D semantic instances into 3D oriented bounding boxes, forming a global spatial semantic representation. To unify high-level semantic reasoning and low-level physical constraints, we introduce a Multi-layer Value Map (MVM) that integrates semantic priorities and reconstructed geometry into a shared cost space, enabling physically grounded geometric planning. Extensive experiments on zero-shot object navigation benchmarks demonstrate that MVP-Nav significantly outperforms existing depth-free methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance and validating that structured physical priors can effectively compensate for the absence of active depth sensors.
tldr: MVP-Nav proposes a zero-shot object goal navigation framework that uses 3D foundation models to reconstruct physical occupancy from monocular RGB, enabling safe and physically grounded navigation without depth sensors.
tldr_zh: MVP-Nav 提出了一种零样本物体目标导航框架，利用3D基础模型从单目RGB重建物理占用，在无深度传感器的情况下实现安全且基于物理的导航。
summary_zh: 零样本物体目标导航（ZSON）仅依赖RGB感知对具身智能体构成根本性挑战，因为显式深度信息的缺失会引发严重的物理不确定性及语义-物理错位。现有方法要么依赖缺乏几何基础的高层语义推理，要么学习缺乏显式物理约束的端到端策略，往往导致语义上合理但物理上不安全的行为。本文提出MVP-Nav——一种具备物理感知能力的纯RGB导航框架，使感知、规划与控制与真实3D世界对齐。MVP-Nav通过利用3D基础模型将2D语义实例投影为3D有向包围盒，从单目观测中重建显式物理占据信息，从而构建全局空间语义表征。为统一高层语义推理与底层物理约束，我们引入多层价值图（MVM），将语义优先级与重建几何信息整合至共享代价空间，实现基于物理的几何规划。在零样本物体目标导航基准上的大量实验表明，MVP-Nav显著优于现有无深度方法，达到最先进性能，验证了结构化物理先验能够有效补偿主动深度传感器的缺失。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Control for an Inline Skating Humanoid Robot
summary: As humanoid robots become increasingly dynamic, coupling them with reinforcement learning offers a promising approach to solving the complex, underactuated mechanics of passive inline skating. Equipping a humanoid robot with passive inline skating wheels presents an opportunity to combine the versatile agility of humanoids with the high-speed, energy-efficient locomotion strategies utilized by human skaters. In this paper, we train and deploy a reinforcement learning control policy that enables novel locomotion strategies for a humanoid robot modified to equip consumer inline skates instead of conventional feet. Unlike previous work limited to quadrupedal robots or actively driven wheels, our system allows for precise 6-DoF control of the skates to execute dynamic, edge-driven propulsion strategies. Our skating strategies emerge entirely from our reward structure, without reliance on human motion data, imitation learning, or kinematic priors. We overcome the inherent instability of passive wheels and simulation contact artifacts by utilizing different geometric wheel models (spherical and ellipsoidal) during training and validation, along with a custom success-based command curriculum and a specialized rolling reward. Consequently, our policy demonstrates up to a 50% reduction in Cost of Transport (CoT) compared to standard walking gaits. The resulting policy successfully transfers zero-shot to the physical Booster T1 hardware. Real-world deployments demonstrate dynamic balance, the ability to reject active physical perturbations, and agile locomotion strategies capable of turning at speed. A video of our results can be found at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-_APcOS7uFo.
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning control policy for a humanoid robot equipped with passive inline skates, achieving dynamic, agile locomotion with reduced energy cost and successful zero-shot transfer to real hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种强化学习控制策略，使配备被动直排轮滑鞋的人形机器人实现动态、敏捷的 locomotion，降低了能耗，并成功零样本迁移到真实硬件。
summary_zh: 随着人形机器人日益具备动态运动能力，将其与强化学习相结合，为解决被动直排轮滑中复杂的欠驱动力学问题提供了有前景的方案。为人形机器人配备被动直排滑轮，使结合人形机器人的多用途灵活性与人类滑冰者所采用的高效高速运动策略成为可能。本文训练并部署了一种强化学习控制策略，使经改装（以消费级直排轮滑鞋替代常规足部）的人形机器人展现出新颖的运动模式。与先前局限于四足机器人或主动驱动轮的研究不同，本系统可对轮滑鞋进行精确的六自由度控制，从而执行基于轮刃驱动的动态推进策略。我们的滑行策略完全源自奖励函数设计，既不依赖人类运动数据，也未使用模仿学习或运动学先验知识。通过采用不同几何轮模型（球体与椭球体）进行训练与验证，结合自定义的成功导向式指令课程及专用滚动奖励，我们克服了被动轮固有的不稳定性及仿真接触伪影问题。实验表明，相较于标准步态，该策略的运输成本可降低高达50%。所得策略成功实现了从仿真到实体Booster T1硬件平台的零样本迁移。实际部署展示了动态平衡能力、主动物理扰动的抵抗能力，以及可实现高速转向的敏捷运动策略。相关结果视频详见https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-_APcOS7uFo。

title: RCT: A Robot-Collected Touch-Vision-Language Dataset for Tactile Generalization
summary: For robots manipulating open-world objects, tactile representations must generalize to unseen materials. We introduce RCT (Robotic Contact Tactile), a robot-collected touch-vision-language dataset with 29,279 tactile frames from full robot presses on 122 industrial reference materials in 7 categories, recorded with three DIGIT sensors at multiple contact positions. RCT preserves each press as a contact sequence, enabling held-out evaluation across materials, categories, sensors, contact positions, and contact sequences. Frames from one press are strongly correlated: frame-random splits can place near-duplicate observations of the same physical interaction in both training and test. With the encoder held fixed, removing contact-sequence overlap reduces tactile-to-text Recall@1 by 17.7 percentage points. When materials are additionally held out at training time, performance drops sharply, leaving held-out-material Recall@1 at 25.1 +/- 6.1% averaged over three held-out draws. The public TVL/HCT split shows the same structure: every test contact sequence appears in training, and raw-pixel nearest neighbors recover the correct sequence in 98.3% of cases. Uniformly sampling a press improves contrastive training, and RCT-trained embeddings improve category probes on unseen materials. RCT makes contact-sequence-aware, held-out-material evaluation reproducible and exposes novel-material generalization as a central challenge for robotic tactile perception. The RCT dataset is open-sourced at https://faerber-lab.github.io/RCT/
tldr: This paper introduces RCT, a robot-collected touch-vision-language dataset designed to evaluate tactile representation generalization to unseen materials, revealing that current models fail at novel-material generalization when contact-sequence overlap is controlled.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍RCT，一个由机器人采集的触觉-视觉-语言数据集，用于评估触觉表示对新材料的泛化能力，并揭示当接触序列重叠被控制时当前模型在新材料泛化上的失败。
summary_zh: 对于操控开放性世界物体的机器人而言，触觉表征必须能够泛化至未见过的材料。我们提出了RCT（机器人接触触觉）数据集——一个由机器人采集的触觉-视觉-语言数据集，包含来自7大类122种工业标准材料的29,279个完整机器人按压触觉帧，使用三个DIGIT传感器在多个接触位置记录。RCT将每次按压保存为一个接触序列，从而支持跨材料、类别、传感器、接触位置及接触序列的留出评估。同一按压产生的帧高度相关：若采用帧随机分割，同一物理交互的近乎重复观测会同时出现在训练集和测试集中。在编码器固定的情况下，移除接触序列重叠导致触觉到文本的Recall@1下降17.7个百分点。当训练时额外留出材料类别，性能急剧下降，三次留出材料抽取的平均Recall@1仅为25.1±6.1%。公开的TVL/HCT分割呈现相同结构：每个测试接触序列都出现在训练集中，且原始像素最近邻在98.3%的案例中能恢复正确序列。对一次按压进行均匀采样可改进对比训练，基于RCT训练的嵌入表示能提升对未见材料的类别探测能力。RCT使得接触序列感知的留出材料评估具有可复现性，并将新材料泛化确立为机器人触觉感知的核心挑战。RCT数据集已在https://faerber-lab.github.io/RCT/开源。

title: Learning Expert Strategy for Autonomous Robotic Endovascular Intervention via Decoupled Procedural Execution
summary: Endovascular interventions are high-stakes procedures requiring precise device operation within complex and tortuous vascular anatomies. Autonomous endovascular navigation has the potential to standardize procedural quality and reduce the performance variability inherent in manual operation. Although Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches have demonstrated promise in enabling autonomy in endovascular intervention, they often struggle with explicit constraint satisfaction and safety guarantees. To address these challenges, a learning-based expert strategy is introduced, enhancing procedural consistency in autonomous endovascular intervention by explicitly decoupling high-level strategic decision-making from low-level procedural execution. The proposed framework replicates the expert clinical decision-making process: a strategic RL policy generates global navigation intents, which are subsequently refined through an expert-informed execution module. This module ensures that robot movements strictly adhere to expert operational norms, real-time kinematic limits, and vessel safety constraints. Experimental evaluation across high-fidelity 3D simulations and a real-world robotic platform demonstrates that the proposed framework not only outperforms baseline policies but also effectively replicates expert-level proficiency. The framework achieves a high navigation success rate (> 96%) and a 29.3% reduction in operational steps, which translates to enhanced operative efficiency and minimized device-vessel interaction. Furthermore, a 13% reduction in trajectory variance indicates superior procedural standardization, aligning autonomous behavior with established clinical norms. These results underscore its potential to enhance the predictability, safety, and consistency of robotic endovascular interventions.
tldr: This paper introduces a decoupled reinforcement learning framework for autonomous endovascular intervention, separating high-level strategic navigation from low-level procedural execution to improve safety, consistency, and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种解耦的强化学习框架用于自主血管内介入手术，通过分离高层策略导航与低层程序执行来提升安全性、一致性和效率。
summary_zh: 血管内介入手术属于高风险操作，需要在复杂迂曲的血管解剖结构中实现精确的器械操控。自主血管内导航有望规范手术质量，减少手动操作固有的操作变异性。尽管强化学习方法在实现血管内介入自主化方面展现出潜力，但其在显式约束满足与安全保障方面仍存在不足。针对这些挑战，本文提出一种基于学习的专家策略，通过将高层级战略决策与低层级操作执行显式解耦，提升自主血管内介入手术的操作一致性。该框架复现了专家级临床决策过程：战略性强化学习策略生成全局导航意图，随后通过专家知识引导的执行模块进行精细化处理。该执行模块确保机器人运动严格遵循专家操作规范、实时运动学限制及血管安全约束。在高保真三维仿真环境与实物机器人平台上的实验评估表明，所提框架不仅优于基线策略，还能有效复现专家级操作水平。该框架实现了高导航成功率（>96%），并将操作步骤减少29.3%，显著提升手术效率并降低器械-血管交互风险。此外，轨迹方差降低13%表明手术标准化程度提升，使自主行为与既定临床规范高度契合。这些结果凸显了该框架在提升机器人血管介入手术的可预测性、安全性与一致性方面的应用潜力。

title: Robustness of Robotic Manipulation: Foundations and Frontiers
summary: Humans and animals exhibit remarkable robustness in physical manipulation, yet robots remain far behind. Progress toward human-level manipulation robustness is hindered by the absence of a unified and systematic understanding: different subfields frame robustness in distinct ways, often leaving the concept ambiguous and limiting deeper analysis as well as communication across research areas. This paper presents a systematic study of manipulation robustness. We begin with a formal definition, characterizing robustness as the degree to which a manipulation system can achieve its goal in the presence of uncertainty and variation. Building on this definition, we introduce general formulations of manipulation robustness from probabilistic and control-theoretic perspectives. We then synthesize the guiding principles and concrete mechanisms of manipulation robustness across perception, planning, control, policy learning, and hardware, illustrating each mechanism through representative works, including foundational and recent studies. In addition, we revisit existing metrics and evaluation methods for quantifying manipulation robustness. Finally, we distill broader lessons for designing robust manipulation systems and discuss open problems and future directions toward achieving human-level robustness in robotic manipulation.
tldr: A comprehensive survey that formally defines manipulation robustness and unifies principles across perception, planning, control, learning, and hardware for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 一篇全面综述，形式化定义操作鲁棒性，并统一感知、规划、控制、学习和硬件等领域的原理。
summary_zh: 人类和动物在物理操作中展现出惊人的鲁棒性，而机器人仍远未达到这一水平。阻碍机器操作达到人类级鲁棒性的关键因素在于缺乏统一且系统化的认知：不同子领域对鲁棒性的定义方式各异，常使该概念模糊不清，从而限制了深入研究及跨研究领域的交流。本文对操作鲁棒性进行了系统性研究。我们首先给出正式定义，将鲁棒性表征为操作系统在存在不确定性和变异时实现目标的程度。基于这一定义，我们从概率论和控制理论视角引入操作鲁棒性的通用形式化表述。随后，我们综合了感知、规划、控制、策略学习及硬件领域实现操作鲁棒性的指导原则与具体机制，并通过代表性工作（包括基础研究与近期研究）阐明每种机制。此外，我们重新审视了量化操作鲁棒性的现有指标与评估方法。最后，我们提炼出设计鲁棒操作系统的普适性经验，并探讨了实现机器人操作人类级鲁棒性的开放问题与未来方向。

title: A Modular Vision-Language-Action Robotics Framework for Indoor Environments
summary: This paper presents an integrated system for the CMU Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Challenge, designed to enable an autonomous agent to perform complex tasks based on natural language instructions. Our framework employs a modular architecture that orchestrates environment mapping, question processing, and navigation. The system operates in two parallel streams: a perception pipeline that constructs a semantic voxel map from real-time camera feeds using OwlViT embeddings, and a language pipeline that classifies user commands with a Vision-Language Model. The mapping is time-constrained; the system proceeds with a partial map if a 500-second exploration limit is reached. The classified query is then grounded in the geometric and semantic context of the map to generate a detailed prompt for the VLM. This yields an actionable output, demonstrating a capable solution for bridging the gap between human language and robotic action.
tldr: A modular VLA system for the CMU VLA Challenge that uses a semantic voxel map and a VLM to ground language commands into robotic actions in indoor environments.
tldr_zh: 一个用于CMU VLA挑战的模块化VLA系统，通过语义体素地图和VLM将语言指令转化为室内环境中的机器人动作。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一套面向CMU视觉-语言-动作（VLA）挑战赛的集成系统，旨在使自主智能体能够基于自然语言指令执行复杂任务。我们的框架采用模块化架构，协调环境地图构建、问题处理与导航功能。系统以两条并行流运行：感知流水线利用OwlViT嵌入从实时摄像头画面构建语义体素地图，语言流水线则通过视觉-语言模型对用户指令进行分类。地图构建受时间约束——若探索时间达到500秒上限，系统将基于部分地图继续推进。随后，分类后的查询指令将被映射到地图的几何与语义背景中，为VLM生成详细提示，最终输出可执行动作。该方案展示了弥合人类语言与机器人动作之间鸿沟的有效能力。

title: Scenario Generation for Testing of Autonomous Driving Systems Using Real-World Failure Records
summary: To ensure safe on-road behavior, pre-deployment testing and failure discovery of Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) is crucial. Present day simulation based testing methods focus largely on mathematical models for efficient search of optimal scenarios, assuming a fixed scenario representation. On the other hand, real-world testing involves substantial manual effort to design scenario templates for testing. These templates represent distinct failure scenarios consisting of pre-deployment vehicle movements, map types, etc. Historical failure records for ADS are a reliable source of real-world failure conditions, which can be used for scenario generation. In this work, we propose a scenario generation pipeline using categorical and contextual information available from historical records in natural language format. Our approach consists of modular LLM based synthetic scenario generation, compatible with the testing constraints of a given system. We successfully apply our method to generate a diverse set of scenarios for testing autonomous navigation on Metadrive simulator using the NHTSA ADS crash records. Our approach results in accurate and diverse scenario generation with a combination of 4 road types, 3 non ego vehicle movement types, including on road anomalies in the form of working zones. Generated scenarios align with the provided testing conditions, and reveals interesting failures of the system within a limited testing budget of 20 scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/anjaliParashar/crash2scenario.
tldr: This paper proposes an LLM-based pipeline that uses natural language from real-world ADS crash records to generate diverse, constraint-compatible scenarios for simulation testing, demonstrating effective failure detection on Metadrive.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于LLM的流程，利用真实世界自动驾驶系统事故记录中的自然语言生成多样化、符合约束的仿真测试场景，并在Metadrive中有效检测系统故障。
summary_zh: 为确保自动驾驶系统（ADS）在道路上的安全行为，部署前的测试和故障发现至关重要。当前的仿真测试方法主要依赖于数学模型，以高效搜索最优场景，并假设场景表示固定不变。另一方面，真实世界测试需要大量人工努力来设计测试场景模板。这些模板代表了由部署前车辆运动、地图类型等构成的典型故障场景。ADS的历史故障记录是真实世界故障条件的可靠来源，可用于场景生成。在本研究中，我们提出了一种利用历史记录中自然语言格式的分类和上下文信息进行场景生成的流程。我们的方法包括基于模块化大语言模型（LLM）的合成场景生成，且与特定系统的测试约束兼容。我们成功应用该方法，利用NHTSA ADS碰撞记录在Metadrive模拟器上生成了多样化的自动驾驶导航测试场景。我们的方法生成了包含4种道路类型、3种非自车运动类型（包括以工作区形式呈现的道路异常）的准确且多样化的场景。生成的场景与给定的测试条件一致，并在20个场景的有限测试预算内揭示了系统中有趣的故障。代码可在 https://github.com/anjaliParashar/crash2scenario 获取。

title: Hierarchical 3D Scene Graph Construction and Belief-based Planning for Semantic Navigation
summary: Semantic navigation is a fundamental task for embodied agents operating in unseen environments, requiring both semantic understanding and long-term decision-making. Recent foundation models have empowered agents with rich semantic priors for this task. However, without structured global representations, decision-making often falls back on local observations and greedy strategies, resulting in inefficient exploration and myopic behaviors, especially in long-distance navigation. To address these challenges, we propose a zero-shot semantic navigation framework. Our method incrementally maintains an online Hierarchical 3D Scene Graph (HSG) to form a multi-granular semantic topology over objects, zones, and regions, serving as a compact state abstraction for global planning. Building on this memory, we introduce a hierarchical belief-based planning framework that fuses semantic priors with exploration evidence on the HSG, and performs finite-horizon rollouts on an HSG-based simulator to explicitly estimate the long-term expected returns of candidate macro-actions. This enables globally consistent decisions and reduces redundant backtracking. Extensive experiments in high-fidelity simulation environments across multiple tasks and datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly in long-distance scenarios, where our approach improves SR and SPL by an average of 9.4\% and 5.0\%, respectively.
tldr: Proposes a zero-shot semantic navigation framework that incrementally builds a hierarchical 3D scene graph and uses belief-based planning with finite-horizon rollouts for long-distance decision-making.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种零样本语义导航框架，通过增量构建层级式3D场景图并利用基于信念的规划进行有限步长推演，实现长距离决策。
summary_zh: 语义导航是具身智能体在未知环境中执行任务的基础能力，既需要语义理解也需要长期决策。近期的基础模型为该任务赋予了智能体丰富的语义先验知识。然而，由于缺乏结构化的全局表征，决策过程常常退化为依赖局部观测与贪婪策略，导致探索效率低下且产生短视行为，尤其在长距离导航中更为突出。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种零样本语义导航框架。该方法在线维护一个层次化三维场景图（HSG），在物体、区域和地带层级上构建多粒度语义拓扑，作为全局规划的紧凑状态抽象。基于此记忆结构，我们引入了一种层次化信念规划框架，该框架在HSG上融合语义先验与探索证据，并在基于HSG的仿真器上执行有限时域展开，以显式估计候选宏观动作的长期期望收益，从而实现全局一致的决策并减少冗余回溯。在多个任务与数据集的高保真仿真环境中进行的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在长距离场景中尤其出色，成功率（SR）和路径长度加权成功率（SPL）分别平均提升9.4%和5.0%，优于现有最优方法。

title: GaussLite: Online Task-Conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Robotic Mapping
summary: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) systems distribute representation capacity uniformly across a scene, ignoring the fact that many downstream robotic tasks engage only a fraction of the reconstructed geometry. This causes valuable onboard compute to be allocated towards optimizing irrelevant parts of the scene, either limiting online capacity or under-optimizing the most relevant parts of the scene. We introduce GaussLite, a task-driven 3DGS mapping system that conditions its representation density on a natural-language task specification. Given a posed RGB-D stream and a task such as "prepare to pick up the object on the desk," GaussLite uses a one-shot LLM parser to extract target and anchor objects, which are grounded per-frame by an open-vocabulary detector and segmented to produce per-pixel relevance masks in real time. The mapper allocates seeding density, gradient flow and scaling by task relevance. At matched Gaussian budget and real-time mapping at 4 Hz on resource-constrained hardware, GaussLite outperforms baselines on ROI PSNR on the Replica Dataset by an average +2.72 dB and on a real-hardware demonstration in indoor and outdoor settings by +2.23 dB. We further show that two task-specialized agents' maps can be fused into a single shared map via per-voxel voting on active-optimization counts in real time, outperforming concatenation by +3.42 dB while only sharing an average 7.08% of the map.
tldr: GaussLite introduces a task-conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting system that uses an LLM parser and open-vocabulary detector to allocate mapping resources (seeding density, gradient flow) preferentially to task-relevant regions, achieving real-time mapping at 4 Hz on resource-constrained hardware with improved ROI PSNR.
tldr_zh: GaussLite提出了一种任务驱动的3D高斯泼溅映射系统，利用LLM解析器和开放词汇检测器将映射资源优先分配给任务相关区域，在资源受限硬件上以4Hz实现实时映射并提升ROI PSNR。
summary_zh: 现有三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）系统在整个场景中均匀分布表征能力，忽略了诸多下游机器人任务仅涉及重建几何局部区域的事实。这导致宝贵的机载算力被用于优化场景中无关部分，要么限制了在线处理能力，要么导致场景最相关区域优化不足。我们提出GaussLite——一种任务驱动的3DGS建图系统，其表征密度根据自然语言任务规范进行条件化配置。给定一个带有位姿的RGB-D数据流及诸如“准备拾取桌面上的物体”等任务指令，GaussLite采用一次性大语言模型解析器提取目标物体与锚点物体，通过开放词汇检测器逐帧定位，经分割后实时生成逐像素相关性掩码。建图模块根据任务相关性分配种子密度、梯度流与缩放比例。在匹配的高斯分布预算及资源受限硬件上以4Hz实时建图的条件下，GaussLite在Replica数据集的感兴趣区域峰值信噪比（ROI PSNR）上平均超出基线2.72dB，在室内外场景的真实硬件演示中平均超出2.23dB。我们进一步证明，通过实时对活跃优化计数进行逐体素投票，可将两个任务专用智能体的地图融合为单一共享地图，该方案相比直接拼接平均仅共享地图的7.08%，却实现了3.42dB的性能提升。

title: Streaming Gaussian Encoding for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking
summary: Camera-based 4D panoptic occupancy tracking (4D-POT) is a promising paradigm for holistic scene understanding from multi-view imagery, enabling joint reasoning about geometry, semantics, and object identities across time. Recent mask-based pipelines achieve strong performance by propagating instance queries across frames. However, their underlying volumetric representations are typically recomputed at each timestep, limiting geometric temporal consistency, particularly under occlusion and for static scene elements. To address this limitation, we propose a streaming Gaussian encoder that maintains a persistent volumetric scene representation for 4D-POT. Our method models the scene as a fixed-size set of latent Gaussian queries that are propagated via ego-motion compensation and refreshed under a confidence-guided budget constraint. Crucially, we shape Gaussian opacities through depth-based supervision to serve as proxy for visibility, enabling confidence to accumulate as a temporally aggregated measure of persistent scene support. Together with a warmup-based multi-frame training strategy, this yields representation-level temporal coherence beyond decoder-only tracking. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-extended nuScenes and Waymo establish a new state-of-the-art for camera-based 4D-POT, improving tracking consistency with negligible computational overhead while remaining fully compatible with existing mask-based pipelines. We provide code and models at https://sge.cs.uni-freiburg.de.
tldr: Proposes a streaming Gaussian encoding method for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking, maintaining persistent scene representations via ego-motion-compensated latent queries and confidence-guided budget constraints to improve temporal consistency in camera-based autonomous driving perception.
tldr_zh: 提出一种流式高斯编码方法用于4D全景占据跟踪，通过自运动补偿的潜在查询和置信度引导的预算约束维持持久场景表示，提升基于相机的自动驾驶感知中的时间一致性。
summary_zh: 基于摄像头的4D全景占据跟踪（4D-POT）是一种从多视角图像实现整体场景理解的有前景范式，能够对几何、语义及跨时间目标身份进行联合推理。近期基于掩码的流水线通过跨帧传播实例查询取得了优异性能。然而，其底层体素表示通常在每个时间步被重新计算，这限制了几何时间一致性，尤其在遮挡场景和静态场景元素下更为显著。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种流式高斯编码器，为4D-POT维护持久的体素场景表示。该方法将场景建模为固定规模的潜在高斯查询集，通过自运动补偿进行传播，并在置信度引导的预算约束下进行刷新。关键创新在于：通过深度监督塑造高斯不透明度以代理可见性，使置信度能够作为持久场景支持的时间聚合度量进行累积。结合基于预训练的多帧训练策略，该方法实现了超越仅解码器跟踪的表示级时间一致性。在Occ3D扩展版nuScenes和Waymo上的大量实验表明，该方法在基于摄像头的4D-POT任务上达到最新最优水平，以可忽略的计算开销提升跟踪一致性，同时保持与现有基于掩码流水线的完全兼容性。代码与模型已开源至https://sge.cs.uni-freiburg.de。

title: MECoBench: A Systematic Study of Multimodal Agent Collaboration in Embodied Environments
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have strong potential as embodied agents, but their ability to collaborate in visually grounded environments remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce MECoBench, a multimodal embodied cooperation benchmark with an evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world tasks, two cooperation structures, and three collaboration modes. Through extensive experiments across various MLLMs, we summarize three key findings: (i) Collaboration generally improves embodied task completion, but its benefits depend on balancing collaborative gains against coordination complexity. (ii) Communication is essential to collaboration gains, while the best collaboration mode depends on team size and model capability. (iii) Moreover, collaboration improves robustness under noisy priors and exploration conditions. Generally, MECoBench provides a systematic testbed for understanding the mechanisms and limits of multimodal embodied collaboration. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/q-i-n-g/MECoBench.
tldr: MECoBench is a benchmark and evaluation platform for studying multimodal agent collaboration in embodied environments, revealing that collaboration generally improves task completion but its benefits depend on balancing gains against coordination complexity, with communication being essential and the best collaboration mode varying by team size and model capability.
tldr_zh: MECoBench是一个用于研究具身环境中多模态智能体协作的基准与评估平台，揭示了协作通常会提高任务完成度，但其效果取决于平衡协作收益与协调复杂性，沟通至关重要，且最佳协作模式因团队规模和模型能力而异。
summary_zh: 近期提出的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在具身智能体方面展现出巨大潜力，但其在视觉化环境中的协作能力仍待深入探究。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了MECoBench——一个多模态具身协作基准测试，其评估平台涵盖多样化的真实世界任务、两种协作结构及三种协作模式。通过针对多种MLLMs的大规模实验，我们总结出三项关键发现：(i) 协作通常能提升具身任务完成度，但其收益取决于协作增益与协调复杂性之间的平衡；(ii) 通信对协作增益至关重要，而最优协作模式则取决于团队规模与模型能力；(iii) 此外，协作能增强模型在噪声先验与探索条件下的鲁棒性。总体而言，MECoBench为理解多模态具身协作的机制与局限性提供了系统化的测试平台。相关代码与数据集已发布于https://github.com/q-i-n-g/MECoBench。

title: SENSE-VAD: Sentient and Semantic Video Anomaly Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) must navigate not only motion-based hazards but also socially complex situations whose danger is constituted by inter-agent relationships rather than movement statistics alone. A child running away from a guardian, a person being carried by another, or a pursuer chasing a pedestrian across a sidewalk are all anomalous in social context, yet none produces an obvious motion signal that current anomaly detectors are equipped to flag. We introduce SENSE-VAD, the first synthetic video anomaly detection benchmark for autonomous driving explicitly designed around socially complex anomalies. Using the CARLA simulator and Unreal Engine (UE), we generate distinct anomaly scenarios across multiple categories: individual behaviors, group behaviors, person--object interactions, cyclist interactions, vehicle & agent, each annotated with per-frame binary labels. A key design principle is the separation of social anomaly from motion-based or appearance-based anomaly: many scenarios involve motion of objects that appears unremarkable in isolation but is anomalous in relational context. We additionally provide real-world normal and anomalous videos as a sim-to-real transfer probe. We evaluate state-of-the-art video anomaly detection baselines and demonstrate that socially complex anomalies constitute a distinct and currently unsolved challenge. Our dataset, annotations, and generation code are publicly available.
tldr: SENSE-VAD introduces a synthetic video anomaly detection benchmark for autonomous driving that focuses on socially complex anomalies (e.g., interpersonal pursuit) which motion-based detectors fail to flag, generated via CARLA and Unreal Engine.
tldr_zh: SENSE-VAD 提出了一个针对自动驾驶的合成视频异常检测基准，专注于运动检测器无法识别的社会性复杂异常（例如人际追逐），使用 CARLA 和 Unreal Engine 生成。
summary_zh: 自主驾驶车辆（AV）不仅需要应对基于运动的危险，还需处理社交复杂情境——其危险性源于主体间的关系，而非单纯的运动统计数据。一个脱离监护人的儿童、被他人抱持的人、或穿越人行道时被追赶的行人，均属社交层面的异常现象，然而这些场景均未产生当前异常检测系统所关注的显著运动信号。我们提出SENSE-VAD，这是首个专为社交复杂异常设计的自动驾驶合成视频异常检测基准。基于CARLA模拟器和虚幻引擎（UE），我们生成了涵盖多类别的不同异常场景：个体行为、群体行为、人-物交互、骑行交互、车辆与智能体，每个场景均标注逐帧二进制标签。其核心设计原则在于将社交异常与基于运动或外观的异常相区分：许多场景中物体的运动看似无异常，但在关系语境下却呈现反常性。此外，我们提供真实世界的正常与异常视频作为仿真-现实迁移探针。通过评估当前最优的视频异常检测基线方法，我们证明社交复杂异常构成了一个独特且尚未解决的挑战。我们的数据集、标注及生成代码均已公开。

title: Real-Time Source-Free Object Detection
summary: Real-world detectors for autonomous driving, surveillance, and robotics must handle domain-shifts under strict latency and memory constraints, yet existing source-free object detection (SFOD) methods rely on heavyweight architectures that prioritize accuracy alone. We show this trade-off is unnecessary: building on YOLOv10, an NMS-free dual-head detector, we achieve state-of-the-art adaptation accuracy while being faster and more compact. We observe that directly applying vanilla mean-teacher self-training to dual-head detectors leads to suboptimal adaptation performance due to two key factors. First, simple pseudo-label generation strategies, such as using a single head or directly combining high-confidence predictions from both heads, yield suboptimal supervision under domain-shift. We propose DHF (Dual-Head Pseudo-Label Fusion) which selectively admits one-to-one (O2O) and one-to-many (O2M) head predictions, preserving precision and recovering missed objects. Second, we observe domain-shift collapses multi-scale feature discriminability. We propose the use of our MARD (Multi-scale Adaptive Representation Diversification) loss which mitigates this by enforcing detection-aware variance and covariance constraints on multi-scale feature maps. Both modules are training-time only, leaving inference unchanged. Across domain-shift benchmarks, our method, RT-SFOD yields 1.4 to 3.5\% mAP gains, 1.3$\times$ higher throughput, with $\sim$2$\times$ fewer parameters than prior state-of-the-art SFOD methods, thus advancing the Pareto frontier of the speed-accuracy-model size trade-off. We report main results with YOLOv10, and demonstrate generalizability with additional YOLO- and DETR-based dual-head detectors. Code is available here: https://github.com/Sairam13001/RT-SFOD/
tldr: This paper introduces RT-SFOD, a source-free object detection method for autonomous driving and robotics that uses a dual-head pseudo-label fusion and multi-scale representation diversification loss to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy with higher throughput and fewer parameters.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RT-SFOD，一种面向自动驾驶和机器人的无源目标检测方法，通过双头伪标签融合和多尺度表示多样化损失，在更高吞吐量和更少参数下实现了最先进的准确率。
summary_zh: 面向自动驾驶、监控及机器人领域的实际检测器，必须在严格的延迟和内存限制下处理域偏移问题，然而现有的无源目标检测方法依赖以精度为唯一优先的重型架构。我们证明这种权衡并非必要：基于无需非极大值抑制的双头检测器YOLOv10，我们在实现最先进的域适应精度的同时，获得了更快速度和更紧凑的模型。我们观察到，直接将标准均值教师自训练方法应用于双头检测器会导致次优的适应性能，这源于两个关键因素。其一，简单的伪标签生成策略（例如仅使用单个检测头，或直接合并两个检测头的高置信度预测）在域偏移下会产生次优的监督信号。为此我们提出DHF（双头伪标签融合），该策略选择性接纳一对一和一对多检测头的预测结果，在保持精度的同时找回遗漏目标。其二，我们发现域偏移会破坏多尺度特征的可判别性。我们提出的MARD（多尺度自适应表征多样化）损失函数通过在多尺度特征图上施加检测感知的方差与协方差约束来缓解此问题。两个模块仅在训练阶段生效，推理过程保持不变。在多个域偏移基准测试中，我们的方法RT-SFOD相比此前最先进的无源目标检测方法，实现了1.4%至3.5%的平均精度增益、1.3倍吞吐量提升，同时参数量减少约2倍，从而推进了速度-精度-模型尺寸的帕累托前沿。我们以YOLOv10报告主要结果，并通过基于YOLO和DETR的其他双头检测器验证了方法的泛化性。代码地址：https://github.com/Sairam13001/RT-SFOD/

title: MemLearner: Learning to Query Context memory for Video World Models
summary: Video World Models are interactive video generation models that predict future world states based on user actions and history video frames. A critical challenge in video world models is the lack of memory, causing inconsistent generated scenes over extended durations. Previous methods explored rule-based context frame retrieval as memory, but they fail to generalize in scenarios with scene occlusions and dynamic objects. We propose MemLearner, a learning-based adaptive context query method using query tokens to bridge context and predicted tokens. By leveraging the video generation model itself for context querying, MemLearner exploits pre-trained visual priors without training additional modules from scratch, and incorporates efficient strategies for training and inference. We collect a dataset of long videos with scene occlusions and dynamic objects, paired with camera pose annotations, and propose a multi-dataset training strategy leveraging both annotated rendered and unannotated real-world videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemLearner significantly outperforms prior video world models in terms of scene consistency and memory, particularly under challenging occlusion and dynamic scenarios.
tldr: MemLearner introduces a learning-based adaptive context query method that leverages the video generation model itself to retrieve relevant context frames, significantly improving scene consistency and memory in video world models under occlusion and dynamic scenarios.
tldr_zh: MemLearner 提出了一种基于学习的自适应上下文查询方法，利用视频生成模型自身来检索相关上下文帧，显著提升了视频世界模型在遮挡和动态场景下的场景一致性和记忆能力。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型是一种交互式视频生成模型，能够根据用户操作和历史视频帧预测未来世界状态。该类模型面临的关键挑战在于缺乏记忆能力，导致长时程生成场景出现不一致。以往方法尝试将基于规则的上下文帧检索作为记忆机制，但难以在场景遮挡和动态物体存在的情况下泛化。我们提出MemLearner——一种基于学习的自适应上下文查询方法，通过查询令牌桥接上下文令牌与预测令牌。MemLearner利用视频生成模型自身进行上下文查询，无需从头训练额外模块即可挖掘预训练的视觉先验，并整合了高效的训练与推理策略。我们收集了包含场景遮挡与动态物体的长视频数据集（附带相机位姿标注），并提出一种多数据集训练策略，该策略同时利用带标注的渲染视频与无标注的真实世界视频。大量实验表明，MemLearner在场景一致性与记忆能力上显著优于先前的视频世界模型，尤其在具有挑战性的遮挡与动态场景中表现突出。

title: One Video, One World: Turning Monocular Video into Physical 4D Scenes
summary: We introduce \textbf{OVOW}, the first training-free system that reconstructs \emph{instance-level, simulation-ready} 4D mesh scenes from a single monocular video. Recent 4D reconstruction achieves impressive rendering quality, but its outputs (\eg, implicit fields, Gaussian primitives, or point clouds) lack the watertight topology, instance separation, and standardized physical interfaces required by physics simulators and embodied AI. OVOW closes this gap with a four-stage pipeline: a vision-language model discovers, labels, and motion-classifies all instances; category-aware reconstruction yields per-instance meshes for rigid objects and topology-consistent mesh sequences for deformable ones; an iterative render-match-optimize procedure recovers metric scale and 6-DoF pose trajectories; and physics-grounded assembly enforces ground contact and inter-object support. Crucially, we model all motion, rigid and non-rigid, through direct vertex deformation without category-specific priors or skeleton rigging, producing watertight mesh scenes ready for downstream physics simulation and editing. We further establish the first benchmark for \emph{structured Video-to-4D} evaluation, with metrics for geometric correctness, instance separation, and physical plausibility beyond visual fidelity; the same pipeline doubles as a scalable engine for \emph{synthesizing} paired video-to-4D simulation data for future 4D world models and embodied AI. Across two synthetic benchmarks (static and 4D), OVOW attains the best overall layout and geometry accuracy and the lowest photometric and semantic error among all baselines, and on monocular video runs one to two orders of magnitude faster than the baselines, while downstream physics simulation confirms its physical stability.
tldr: OVOW is a training-free system that reconstructs instance-level, simulation-ready 4D mesh scenes from a single monocular video, enabling downstream physics simulation and embodied AI applications.
tldr_zh: OVOW是一个无需训练的系统，能从单目视频重建实例级、可直接用于模拟的4D网格场景，支持下游物理模拟和具身AI应用。
summary_zh: 我们提出 **OVOW**，这是首个无需训练即可从单目视频重建出**实例级、可仿真**4D网格场景的系统。近年来的4D重建取得了令人印象深刻的渲染质量，但其输出（如隐式场、高斯基元或点云）缺乏物理仿真器与具身人工智能所需的防水拓扑、实例分离以及标准化物理接口。OVOW通过四阶段管线填补了这一空白：视觉语言模型发现、标注并对所有实例进行运动分类；类别感知重建生成刚性物体的逐实例网格与可变形物体的拓扑一致网格序列；迭代渲染-匹配-优化流程恢复度量尺度与6自由度位姿轨迹；基于物理的装配确保地面接触与物体间支撑关系。关键在于，我们通过直接的顶点变形对所有运动（刚性与非刚性）进行建模，无需类别先验或骨骼绑定，从而生成可供下游物理仿真与编辑直接使用的防水网格场景。我们进一步建立了首个**结构化视频到4D**评估基准，其指标涵盖几何正确性、实例分离及超越视觉保真度的物理合理性；同一管线也可作为可扩展引擎，用于**合成**配对视频到4D仿真数据，以支持未来的4D世界模型与具身人工智能。在两个合成基准（静态与4D）上，OVOW在所有基线中取得了最优的整体布局与几何精度，以及最低的光度与语义误差；在单目视频上运行速度比基线快一至两个数量级，且下游物理仿真验证了其物理稳定性。

title: HSDF-Lane: Height-Aligned Signed Distance Field with Semantic Lane Prior for 3D Lane Detection
summary: Monocular 3D lane detection plays a critical role in autonomous driving, yet recovering reliable 3D geometry from a single image remains challenging due to inherent depth ambiguity. Prior methods project image features into Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) space under a flat-ground assumption, causing geometric distortion on real-world roads. Recent methods instead predict explicit height maps to capture non-planar surfaces, but still rely on sparse anchor-based regression and exploit the recovered geometry merely for spatial transformation rather than semantic understanding. To overcome these limitations, we propose HSDF-Lane, which implicitly models the road surface as a Height-aligned Signed Distance Field (HSDF) over a densely sampled 3D feature volume. Through differentiable rendering, the HSDF jointly produces an accurate height map and surface-aligned features. We further introduce Lane-aware Semantic Positional Encoding (LSPE), which injects a lane-existence prior derived from the surface-aligned features into the transformer queries, coupling geometric structure with semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on the OpenLane benchmark show that HSDF-Lane achieves state-of-the-art performance in both 3D lane detection and height map estimation.
tldr: HSDF-Lane proposes a Height-aligned Signed Distance Field (HSDF) to implicitly model road surface geometry and a Lane-aware Semantic Positional Encoding (LSPE) to inject lane existence priors, achieving state-of-the-art 3D lane detection on the OpenLane benchmark.
tldr_zh: HSDF-Lane 提出高度对齐符号距离场隐式建模路面几何，并引入车道感知语义位置编码注入车道存在先验，在 OpenLane 基准上实现 3D 车道检测的最优性能。
summary_zh: 单目3D车道检测在自动驾驶中至关重要，但由于固有的深度模糊性，从单张图像恢复可靠的3D几何结构仍具有挑战性。现有方法在平面地面假设下将图像特征投影到鸟瞰图空间，导致真实道路场景中出现几何畸变。最新方法通过预测显式高度图来捕捉非平面表面，但仍依赖稀疏的基于锚点的回归，且将恢复的几何结构仅用于空间变换而非语义理解。为突破这些局限，我们提出HSDF-Lane，该模型在密集采样的3D特征体上隐式地将道路表面建模为高度对齐符号距离场。通过可微渲染，HSDF联合生成精确的高度图和表面对齐特征。我们进一步引入车道感知语义位置编码，将从表面对齐特征中提取的车道存在先验注入Transformer查询中，使几何结构与语义引导相结合。在OpenLane基准上的大量实验表明，HSDF-Lane在3D车道检测和高度图估计中均达到最先进性能。

title: Horizon3D: Sparse Radar-Camera Fusion for Long-Range 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving
summary: Long-range 3D object detection is critical for safe autonomous driving at highway speeds, yet existing radar-camera fusion methods remain limited at extended ranges. BEV-based methods capture scene-level context but incur rapidly growing computation and often lose fine-grained object detail, while query-based methods are efficient but provide limited scene-level context. Temporal fusion further requires both multi-frame accumulation for sparse distant observations and object-level motion modeling for fast-moving objects. We propose Horizon3D, a sparse radar-camera fusion framework for long-range 3D object detection that combines Gaussian primitives with sparse BEV features. Horizon3D initializes Gaussian primitives at radar- and camera-estimated object keypoints using Keypoint-Guided Gaussian Initialization, refines them through Object-Centric Sparse Fusion, and splats them onto the BEV plane to fuse object-level detail with sparse radar BEV context. It further introduces Dual-Path Temporal Fusion, which aggregates temporal cues through a BEV path for scene-level accumulation and a Gaussian path for object-level motion propagation. Experiments on TruckScenes show that Horizon3D achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera 3D detection performance. On the validation set, it outperforms the previous best method by +3.0 NDS and +1.6 mAP while maintaining competitive inference speed.
tldr: Proposes a sparse radar-camera fusion framework with Gaussian primitives and dual-path temporal fusion for long-range 3D object detection in autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种结合高斯原语和双路径时间融合的稀疏雷达-摄像头融合框架，用于自动驾驶中的远距离3D目标检测，取得了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 远程三维物体检测对于高速公路速度下的安全自动驾驶至关重要，但现有的雷达-相机融合方法在扩展距离上仍然存在局限。基于BEV的方法能捕获场景级上下文，但计算量快速增长且常丢失细粒度物体细节，而基于查询的方法虽高效但提供的场景级上下文有限。时间融合需要同时实现稀疏远距离观测的多帧累积和快速移动物体的物体级运动建模。我们提出Horizon3D——一种结合高斯基元与稀疏BEV特征的稀疏雷达-相机融合框架，用于远程三维物体检测。Horizon3D通过关键点引导的高斯初始化在雷达和相机估计的物体关键点处初始化高斯基元，通过以物体为中心的稀疏融合进行细化，并将其溅射到BEV平面以融合物体级细节与稀疏雷达BEV上下文。该框架还引入双路径时间融合，通过BEV路径进行场景级累积和通过高斯路径进行物体级运动传播来聚合时间线索。在TruckScenes上的实验表明，Horizon3D实现了最先进的雷达-相机三维检测性能。在验证集上，它比此前最优方法提升了+3.0 NDS和+1.6 mAP，同时保持具有竞争力的推理速度。

title: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
summary: Latent world models enable planning from high-dimensional observations by predicting future states in a compact latent space. However, these models are typically kept frozen at test time: when their predictions become inaccurate, planning can fail, especially under test-time distribution shift. To address this, we propose AdaJEPA, an adaptive latent world model that performs test-time adaptation within the closed loop of model predictive control (MPC). After training, AdaJEPA plans and executes the first action chunk, uses the observed next-state transition as a self-supervised adaptation signal, and replans with the updated model. This closed-loop update continuously recalibrates the world model without additional expert demonstrations. Across a range of goal-reaching tasks, AdaJEPA substantially improves planning success with as few as one gradient step per MPC replanning step.
tldr: AdaJEPA introduces a latent world model that adapts at test time via closed-loop MPC, using observed transitions as self-supervised signals to improve planning under distribution shift.
tldr_zh: AdaJEPA 提出了一种在模型预测控制的闭环中进行测试时适应的潜在世界模型，利用实际观测到的状态转移进行自监督更新，从而提升规划成功率。
summary_zh: 潜变量世界模型通过在一个紧凑的潜空间中预测未来状态，从而能够基于高维观测进行规划。然而，这些模型在测试时通常保持冻结：当它们的预测变得不准确时，尤其是在测试时出现分布偏移的情况下，规划可能会失败。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AdaJEPA，一种自适应的潜变量世界模型，能够在模型预测控制（MPC）的闭环内进行测试时自适应。训练完成后，AdaJEPA规划并执行第一个动作片段，将观测到的下一个状态转移作为自监督自适应信号，并利用更新后的模型重新进行规划。这种闭环更新可持续地重新校准世界模型，无需额外的专家示范。在一系列目标到达任务中，AdaJEPA在每次MPC重新规划步骤中仅需一个梯度步骤，即可显著提升规划成功率。

title: Safe Online Learning via Smooth Safety-Structured Policy Composition
summary: Safe online reinforcement learning requires policies to respect safety constraints while maintaining smooth optimization dynamics. Existing approaches typically rely on either strict safety enforcement via action interventions, which introduce discontinuities in system interaction and learning, or soft safety constraint formulations, which preserve smooth learning but provide limited safety assurance. We propose AutoSafe, a safety-aware policy architecture that integrates structured safety monitoring and intervention directly into the action generation process. This design enables smooth, risk-dependent transitions between performance-driven and safety-preserving behaviors, resulting in continuous online interaction and learning dynamics. Empirical results across a suite of continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate strong safety enforcement without sacrificing learning smoothness. We further validate AutoSafe on a physical cart-pole system, highlighting its practical effectiveness for safe online learning in the real world.
tldr: AutoSafe introduces a safety-aware policy architecture that integrates structured safety monitoring directly into action generation, enabling smooth, risk-dependent transitions between performance and safety in online RL, validated on continuous-control benchmarks and a physical cart-pole system.
tldr_zh: AutoSafe 提出了一种安全感知的策略架构，将结构化安全监控直接集成到动作生成中，实现在线强化学习中性能与安全行为之间的平滑、风险依赖转换，在连续控制基准和物理倒立摆系统上得到验证。
summary_zh: 安全在线强化学习要求策略在保持优化动态平滑的同时满足安全约束。现有方法通常依赖两种途径：通过动作干预实现严格安全执行——这会在系统交互与学习过程中引入不连续性；或采用软安全约束公式——虽能保障学习平滑性，但安全保证能力有限。我们提出AutoSafe，一种将结构化安全监控与干预直接集成至动作生成过程的安全感知策略架构。该设计能够在性能驱动行为与安全保持行为之间实现平滑的、风险依赖的转换，从而保证连续在线交互与学习动态。在连续控制基准测试套件上的实验结果表明，该方法在不牺牲学习平滑性的前提下实现了强有力的安全保障。我们进一步在物理倒立摆系统上验证了AutoSafe，凸显其在真实世界安全在线学习中的实际效用。

title: LLM-Powered Interactive Robotic Action Synthesis from Multimodal Speech, Gestures, and Music
summary: The quest for intuitive and natural human-robot interaction (HRI) remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional methods often rely on rigid, pre-programmed commands that limit the robot's expressiveness and adaptability. This paper introduces a novel framework that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to synthesize complex robotic actions from a rich tapestry of multimodal human inputs: natural speech, hand gestures, and music/sound beats. Our system architecture integrates a speech transcription model, a gesture recognition module, and a signal processing pipeline for beat detection. These processed inputs are contextualized using prompt templates and fed into a LLM. The LLM, informed by a predefined robot action space, reasons over the combined inputs to generate a coherent sequence of actions. This sequence is dispatched to an action queue for execution on a quadruped robot over ROS. The framework has ability to interpret and fuse semantic commands from speech, deictic information from gestures, and rhythmic cues from music. This work represents a step towards creating robots that can interact with humans in a more fluid, creative, and context-aware manner.
tldr: This paper presents an LLM-based framework that integrates speech, gesture, and music inputs to generate coherent action sequences for a quadruped robot, aiming to enhance human-robot interaction expressiveness and adaptability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的框架，整合语音、手势和音乐输入，为四足机器人生成连贯的动作序列，旨在提升人机交互的表达力和适应性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
追求直观自然的⼈机交互（HRI）仍是机器人领域的一项重大挑战。传统方法往往依赖僵化、预设的指令，限制了机器人的表现力与适应性。本文提出一种新型框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，从丰富的多模态人类输入（自然语言、手势、音乐/节拍）中合成复杂的机器人动作。我们的系统架构集成了语音转录模型、手势识别模块以及用于节拍检测的信号处理流程。这些处理后的输入通过提示模板进行上下文化，并馈入大语言模型。LLM依据预定义的机器人动作空间，对融合后的输入进行推理，生成连贯的动作序列。该序列被发送至基于ROS运行的四足机器人的动作队列中执行。该框架能够解释并融合语音中的语义指令、手势中的指向信息以及音乐中的节奏线索。这项工作为构建能以更流畅、更具创造性且更具情境感知能力的方式与人类交互的机器人迈出了一步。

title: MultiUAV-Plat: An LLM-Oriented Platform, Benchmark and Framework for Multi-UAV Collaborative Task Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide a promising interface for high-level robotic task planning, but their use in multi-UAV collaboration remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Existing UAV simulators mainly emphasize dynamics, perception, or low-level control, while existing LLM-agent benchmarks rarely capture aerial-robotics constraints such as partial observability, spatial coverage, UAV assignment, and multi-vehicle coordination. To bridge this gap, we present MultiUAV-Plat, a lightweight, easy-to-use, LLM-agent-oriented simulation platform for multi-UAV collaborative task planning. The platform exposes concise RESTful APIs, agent-facing observations, role-based information access, hidden validation logic, and optional 2D/3D visualization, allowing agents to solve missions through realistic tool interaction rather than privileged simulator access. Built on this platform, the MultiUAV-Plat Benchmark contains 75 mission sessions, 1500 natural-language tasks, and 9396 validation checks across target assignment, area search, and area assignment and patrol scenarios. We further propose Agent4Drone, a task-specific LLM agent framework that structures multi-UAV behavior into memory, observation, task understanding, planning, execution, and verification. In a full paired benchmark comparison, Agent4Drone achieves a 57.9% task pass rate, a 74.6% average task check pass rate, and a 72.0% global check pass rate, substantially outperforming a ReAct baseline at 30.6%, 47.9%, and 43.1%, respectively. Agent4Drone also reduces the total failed task rate from 32.4% to 12.9%. These results demonstrate that MultiUAV-Plat and MultiUAV-Plat Benchmark provide a reproducible foundation for studying LLM-driven multi-UAV autonomy under realistic information and execution constraints.
tldr: This paper introduces MultiUAV-Plat, a simulation platform and benchmark for evaluating LLM-driven multi-UAV collaborative task planning, along with Agent4Drone, a task-specific LLM agent framework that significantly outperforms a ReAct baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MultiUAV-Plat，一个用于评估LLM驱动的多无人机协作任务规划的仿真平台和基准，以及Agent4Drone，一个任务特定的LLM智能体框架，其性能显著优于ReAct基线。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）为高层级机器人任务规划提供了极具前景的接口，但其在多无人机协作中的应用仍难以系统性地评估。现有无人机模拟器主要侧重动力学、感知或低层级控制，而现有的LLM智能体基准测试鲜少涵盖空中机器人面临的约束，如部分可观测性、空间覆盖范围、无人机分配及多机协同。为填补这一空白，我们提出MultiUAV-Plat——一个轻量级、易用、面向LLM智能体的多无人机协作任务规划仿真平台。该平台提供简洁的RESTful API、面向智能体的观测信息、基于角色的数据访问、隐藏的验证逻辑以及可选的2D/3D可视化，使智能体能够通过逼真的工具交互而非特权访问模拟器来完成任务。基于该平台，MultiUAV-Plat基准测试包含75个任务会话、1500项自然语言任务及9396次验证检查，覆盖目标分配、区域搜索、区域分配与巡逻等场景。我们进一步提出Agent4Drone——一种面向任务的LLM智能体框架，将多无人机行为结构化为记忆、观测、任务理解、规划、执行与验证六大模块。在完整的配对基准对比中，Agent4Drone的任务通过率达到57.9%，平均任务检查通过率74.6%，全局检查通过率72.0%，显著优于ReAct基线（分别为30.6%、47.9%和43.1%）。同时，Agent4Drone将总失败任务率从32.4%降至12.9%。这些结果表明，MultiUAV-Plat与MultiUAV-Plat基准测试为研究LLM驱动下的多无人机自主系统在真实信息与执行约束下的表现提供了可复现的基础。

title: The Quadruped Soft Tail: Compliant Grasping and Swabbing for Contamination Surveys in Harsh Environments
summary: Beryllium contamination surveys in radioactive areas are challenging for robots in environments cluttered with cables and electronics. To address this problem, we have developed a novel quadruped system augmentation: A lightweight, soft, and compliant tendon-actuated robotic tail mounted on a quadruped robot. The tail features a hollow, flexible backbone and a tendon-actuated soft gripper that enables the robot to pick up sampling tissues, swab contaminated surfaces, and release the tissues at designated collection locations for subsequent beryllium analysis. To enable intuitive teleoperation, a closed-form kinematic model and a singularity-robust task-space controller are developed. Experimental results demonstrate that gripper actuation has a negligible effect on robot shape, while common-mode tendon actuation provides an effective mechanism for stiffness modulation and preload control. Furthermore, experimental validation indicates that the proposed kinematic model provides a suitable basis for real-time task-space control. The proposed system combines the agility of legged locomotion with the compliance of soft robotic manipulation, enabling the complete contamination-survey procedure to be performed without human exposure. While motivated by beryllium contamination surveys at CERN, the proposed quadruped soft-tail concept is broadly applicable to legged robots operating in cluttered, confined, or hazardous environments where conventional rigid-link manipulators are undesirable.
tldr: A soft, compliant tendon-actuated tail with a gripper is mounted on a quadruped robot to enable safe beryllium contamination swabbing and sample collection in radioactive, cluttered environments, combining legged locomotion with soft manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种安装在四足机器人上的轻量软体肌腱驱动尾部，结合柔性夹爪，实现对放射性环境中铍污染物的安全擦拭与样本采集，融合了足式运动与软体操作。
summary_zh: 在放射性区域进行铍污染调查时，面对布满电缆和电子设备的复杂环境，机器人面临巨大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种新型四足系统增强装置：一种轻量化、柔性且顺应性高的肌腱驱动式机器人尾部，安装于四足机器人之上。该尾部采用中空柔性脊柱结构，并配备肌腱驱动式软体夹爪，使机器人能够拾取采样拭子、擦拭污染表面，并将拭子释放至指定收集点以供后续铍元素分析。为实现直观的远程操控，我们建立了闭合运动学模型，并开发了面向奇异性鲁棒的任务空间控制器。实验结果表明，夹爪驱动对机器人形态的影响可忽略不计，而共模肌腱驱动则为刚度调节与预紧力控制提供了有效机制。此外，实验验证表明，所提出的运动学模型为实时任务空间控制提供了良好的基础。该系统将足式运动的敏捷性与软体操控的柔顺性相结合，使得整个污染调查流程可在无人员暴露的情况下完成。尽管本研究源于欧洲核子研究中心（CERN）的铍污染调查需求，但所提出的四足软尾概念可广泛适用于在杂乱、受限或危险环境中运行的足式机器人——这些场景中传统刚性机械臂往往难以适用。

title: Sampling-Based Coordination-Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Robot Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-robot systems must simultaneously optimize competing objectives while maintaining coordinated behavior. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches often rely on fixed or centralized coordination, which limits adaptability and violates distributed constraints. This work introduces the Coordination-Informed Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (CIMORL) framework, integrating a distributed weight prediction mechanism, a privileged expert training strategy, and theoretical guarantees for Pareto-optimal solutions. We present the base CIMORL method alongside two sampling-based variants, CIMORL-TS (Tree Search) and CIMORL-MPPI (MPPI), which leverage privileged global information during training to enable fully decentralized deployment. Experimental validation in cooperative and adversarial scenarios demonstrates a $21.2\%$ hypervolume improvement and superior policy stability compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Real-world experiments with Crazyflie drones further validate the framework's robustness in resource allocation and multi-attacker multi-defend scenarios under partial observability.
tldr: This paper introduces CIMORL, a multi-robot reinforcement learning framework that combines a distributed weight prediction mechanism, privileged expert training, and sampling-based variants to achieve Pareto-optimal coordination under competing objectives, validated with Crazyflie drone experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CIMORL，一种结合分布式权重预测、特权专家训练和基于抽样的变体的多机器人强化学习框架，旨在在竞争目标下实现帕累托最优协调，并在Crazyflie无人机实验中验证了其鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 多机器人系统需在保持协同行为的同时，同步优化相互冲突的目标。现有基于多智能体强化学习的方法往往依赖固定或集中式协调机制，这限制了系统的适应性，且违背了分布式约束条件。本研究提出协同感知多目标强化学习（CIMORL）框架，该框架整合了分布式权重预测机制、特权专家训练策略，以及帕累托最优解的理论保证。我们提出了基础CIMORL方法及其两种基于采样的变体——CIMORL-TS（树搜索）与CIMORL-MPPI（MPPI），这两种变体在训练阶段利用特权全局信息，从而实现完全去中心化的部署。在协作与对抗场景中的实验验证表明，相较于现有最优基线方法，本方法实现了21.2%的超体积改进，并展现出更优的策略稳定性。基于Crazyflie无人机的真实场景实验进一步验证了该框架在部分可观测条件下，于资源分配及多攻击者-多防御者场景中的鲁棒性。

title: AeroVerse-SatAgent: UAV-Satellite Collaborative Spatial Reasoning Inspired by the Dual Visual Pathway Theory of Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: With the rapid advancement of aerospace embodied intelligence, enabling Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to autonomously understand and reason about complex environments has become increasingly important. However, existing UAV-based spatial reasoning approaches face critical limitations: single-view perception renders them vulnerable to occlusions and perspective distortions, while most VLMs lack explicit geometric modeling, relying on semantic cues and yielding inconsistent reasoning under viewpoint and scale variations. To address these challenges, we propose SatAgent, a UAV-Satellite collaborative spatial reasoning model inspired by the dual-pathway mechanism of the human visual system. By jointly leveraging satellite and UAV perspectives, SatAgent enables robust, accurate reasoning in complex urban environments. We first introduce a Geometric-Aware 3D Reconstruction Encoder that elevates 2D UAV features into explicit 3D spatial representations. Next, we design a multi-view topology-semantic alignment module integrating cross-view features within a unified BEV coordinate system. We further introduce a multi-view consistency loss encouraging viewpoint-invariant representations. Finally, we construct SatAgent-SR130K, the first large-scale UAV-Satellite collaborative multi-view spatial reasoning dataset. Experiments show SatAgent outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose foundation models and specialized spatial reasoning models by 25.91\% and 11.69\%, respectively, across diverse tasks, achieving particularly high accuracy in complex geometric relationship reasoning.
tldr: SatAgent is a UAV-Satellite collaborative spatial reasoning model that integrates geometric-aware 3D reconstruction and multi-view topology-semantic alignment, outperforming existing foundation models on complex spatial reasoning tasks by over 25%.
tldr_zh: SatAgent 是一种无人机与卫星协同的空间推理模型，结合几何感知的3D重建和多视图拓扑-语义对齐，在复杂空间推理任务上比现有基础模型提升超过25%。
summary_zh: 随着航空航天具身智能的快速发展，使无人机能够自主理解和推理复杂环境变得日益重要。然而，现有基于无人机的空间推理方法存在关键局限性：单视角感知使其易受遮挡和透视畸变影响，而多数视觉语言模型缺乏显式几何建模，依赖语义线索，在视角和尺度变化下会产生不一致的推理结果。为解决这些挑战，我们提出卫星体——一种受人类视觉系统双通路机制启发的无人机-卫星协同空间推理模型。通过联合利用卫星与无人机视角，卫星体能够在复杂城市环境中实现稳健、准确的推理。我们首先引入几何感知三维重建编码器，将二维无人机特征提升为显式三维空间表征。随后设计多视角拓扑-语义对齐模块，在统一鸟瞰图坐标系中融合跨视角特征。进一步提出多视角一致性损失函数，以鼓励视角不变表征。最后构建卫星体-空间推理13万数据集——首个大规模无人机-卫星协同多视角空间推理数据集。实验表明，卫星体在多样化任务上分别以25.91%和11.69%的绝对优势超越最先进的通用基础模型与专用空间推理模型，尤其在高精度几何关系推理任务中表现卓越。

title: Knowledge-Driven Dimension Estimation from a Single Image -3D Asset Generation Technology for Digital Twin Construction
summary: In the verification of in-vehicle cameras, simulation technology using virtual spaces has advanced, enabling pre-evaluation of false detections and missed detections in various scenarios. However, discrepancies in the scale of the object being verified between the virtual and real environments can lead to a decrease in camera recognition performance. For traffic signs installed at high altitudes, distance measurement using LiDAR or stereo cameras is difficult, requiring size estimation from monocular images. This paper proposes a method for estimating the scale of an object by decomposing it into multiple structural elements and integrating external knowledge regarding design rules, geometric relationships, and conventional dimensions. Specifically, this method detects each component from a monocular image and estimates the size of each component by considering its structural relationships and dimensional consistency with surrounding elements. Furthermore, it generates a 3D asset of the object by reconstructing the estimated components. This method makes it possible to place 3D assets with a scale approximating the real environment within a digital twin space and is expected to contribute to improving the verification accuracy of in-vehicle cameras for autonomous driving in virtual environments.
tldr: This paper proposes a knowledge-driven method to estimate the scale of objects (e.g., traffic signs) from a single monocular image by decomposing them into structural components and integrating external design knowledge, then generating 3D assets for digital twin construction to improve in-vehicle camera verification for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种知识驱动的单目图像物体尺度估计方法，通过将物体分解为多个结构元素并融合外部设计知识，生成逼真的3D资产用于数字孪生构建，从而提升自动驾驶车载相机在虚拟环境中的验证精度。
summary_zh: 在车载摄像头的验证过程中，利用虚拟空间的仿真技术已取得进展，能够在多种场景下对误检和漏检进行预评估。然而，虚拟环境与真实环境中所验证目标的尺度差异可能导致摄像头识别性能下降。对于安装在高处的交通标志，使用激光雷达或立体摄像头进行距离测量较为困难，因此需要从单目图像中估计其尺寸。本文提出一种目标尺度估计方法，通过将目标分解为多个结构元素，并融合关于设计规则、几何关系及常规尺寸的外部知识。具体而言，该方法从单目图像中检测每个组件，并通过考虑其结构关系及与周围元素的尺寸一致性来估计各组件的大小。此外，该方法通过重建估计出的组件生成目标的三维资产。这一方法使得在数字孪生空间中放置与真实环境尺度相近的三维资产成为可能，有望提升虚拟环境下自动驾驶车载摄像头的验证精度。

title: Autonomous UAV Navigation for Individual Wildlife Re-Identification
summary: Reliable individual re-identification (re-ID) of wildlife is essential for population monitoring, behavioral tracking, and conservation policy evaluation, yet large-scale data collection remains labor-intensive, relying on manual efforts by ecologists or citizen scientists. We propose an autonomous drone navigation system that actively optimizes image capture for downstream re-ID, moving beyond passive aerial sensing. The system combines YOLOv11 object detection with a DINOv2-based pose classifier to guide real-time flight decisions: detecting animals, orienting to expose the lateral flank (the surface of interest for pattern-based re-ID), and approaching until the subject meets a minimum bounding-box threshold. Unlike prior drone systems that optimize for group-level behavioral video, ours targets the specific image-quality requirements of individual-identification models. We demonstrate feasibility through a case study on zebra using footage collected in Kenya, and show the approach generalizes to other species with diagnostic surface patterns, including giraffes, tigers, and elephants. Our work establishes a framework for task-aware embodied AI for ecological data collection, in which downstream re-ID requirements drive real-time perception and control.
tldr: Proposes an autonomous UAV navigation system that uses YOLOv11 and DINOv2 to optimize image capture for individual wildlife re-identification, demonstrated on zebras and other patterned species.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种自主无人机导航系统，利用YOLOv11和DINOv2优化针对野生动物个体重识别的图像采集，并在斑马等物种上进行了验证。

title: Diffusion-based 4D Trajectory Prediction and Distributed Control for UAV Swarms
summary: Accurate 4D trajectory prediction and closed-loop tracking are essential for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms to achieve safe and efficient operations in complex low-altitude environments such as urban airspaces, industrial sites, and indoor facilities.
